articleTitle: Coherent Receivers for Practical Optical Communication Systems
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Coherent receivers that utilize electrical signal processing techniques have attracted increased attention over the last couple of years. In this paper, we will discuss some practical aspects of these receivers and present some recent results.

articleTitle: QoS-Aware Scheduling over Hybrid Optical Wireless Networks
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Hybrid optical wireless networks present the future-proof solution to the currently deployed copper access infrastructure. Purposing to increase the network throughput under the hybrid framework, we propose a scheduling scheme to deliver diverse services by taking the quality of service (QoS) requirement into consideration. Simulation results demonstrate that our scheme is capable of collecting the QoS requirement information throughout the network, and the centralized process facilitates the reduction of network transmission overhead.

articleTitle: RADAR: Risk-and-Delay Aware Routing Algorithm in a Hybrid Wireless-Optical Broadband Access Network (WOBAN)
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose "risk-and-delay aware routing algorithm" (RADAR) for WOBAN. RADAR minimizes packet delay in the wireless front end of WOBAN and reduces packet loss for multiple failure scenarios: gateway failure, ONU failure, and OLT failure.

articleTitle: 107-Gb/s full-ETDM transmission over field installed fiber using vestigial sideband modulation
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: 107-Gb/s full-ETDM transmission is shown over a 160-km field installed fiber link. A high tolerance towards narrowband optical filtering is demonstrated using vestigial sideband modulation to minimize the spectral width.

articleTitle: Demonstration of RSOA-based remote modulation at 2.5 and 5 Gbit/s for WDM PON
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: This paper investigates the performance of a reflective semiconductor optical amplifier in a bidirectional wavelength-division multiplexed passive optical network at 2.5 and 5 Gbit/s over 20 and 15 dB link budget.

articleTitle: Demonstration of a Radio over Fibre Distributed Antenna Network for Combined In-building WLAN and 3G Coverage
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A RF-over-fibre distributed multi-antenna network is demonstrated to improve coverage and reduce the required dynamic range of co-existing IEEE 802.11 g WLAN and 3G services by using overlapping cells, fed from a single signal source.

articleTitle: 160-Gb/s, 16-Channel Full-Duplex, Single-Chip CMOS Optical Transceiver
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We report a single-chip CMOS optical transceiver incorporating sixteen 10-Gb/s transmitter and receiver channels for a 160 Gb/s aggregate bit rate. The transceiver consumes 15.6 mW/Gb/s with an area efficiency of 9.4 Gb/s/mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> per link.

articleTitle: Implementing a Path Computation Element (PCE) to encompass physical impairments in transparent networks
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A PCE implementation is presented and evaluated in single-area, multi-area, and multi-layer networks. The proposed implementation provides not only efficient bandwidth utilization with good scalability performance but it allows also to encompass physical impairment constraints.

articleTitle: Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing using Baseband Optical Single Sideband for Simpler Adaptive Dispersion Compensation
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A novel baseband OFDM optical single-sideband system is proposed for long-haul adaptive dispersion compensation. Simulations on a dispersive 420 km link show that non linear fibre effects and MZ modulator intermodulation effects will be the limiting factors on system performance.

articleTitle: Impairment Constraint Based Routing in Mesh Optical Networks
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present a framework for the alleviation of the main problems induced due to optical transparency based on the use of advanced optical performance monitoring, physical layer modeling tools, and new algorithms for routing.

articleTitle: Transmission of 42.8Gbit/s Polarization Multiplexed NRZ-QPSK over 6400km of Standard Fiber with no Optical Dispersion Compensation
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We report the longest reach achieved for a 42.8 Gbit/s system on standard fiber with no optical dispersion compensation. Using a digital coherent receiver a record total dispersion of 107,424 ps/nm was compensated with 1.2 dB OSNR penalty.

articleTitle: TDM-PON Security Issues: Upstream Encryption is Needed
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: TDM-PONs (E/B/GPON) present several security issues that can easily be exploited by malicious users. We summarize these issues and present experimental results to demonstrate that, in particular, upstream encryption is required to prevent eavesdropping.

articleTitle: Deployment of Carrier-Grade Bandwidth-on-Demand Services over Optical Transport Networks: A Verizon Experience
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: In September 2006, Verizon partner solutions (VPS) launched the bandwidth-on-demand (BoD) service trial in New York City, as a precursor to the formal rollout of just-in-time provisioning (JiT) service in 2007. The JiT service will offer wholesale customers OC-n, Ethernet private line, and DS3 services utilizing a GMPLS-based intelligent optical network to reduce provisioning intervals. This paper presents Verizon's experience in deploying BoD/JiT Provisioning services, and identifies technology gaps and operations challenges.

articleTitle: Applying p-Cycles in Dynamic Provisioning of Survivable Multicast Sessions in Optical WDM Networks
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Network survivability is crucial to multicast traffic. We propose applying p-cycles to dynamic provisioning of survivable multicast traffic. We show that p-cycle-based multicast protection approaches offer much better performance compared with other shared multicast protection approaches.

articleTitle: Electronic post-compensation for nonlinear phase noise in a 1000-km 20-Gbit/s optical QPSK transmission system using the homodyne receiver with digital signal processing
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Abstract: We demonstrate electronic post-compensation for nonlinear phase noise in a 1000-km 20-Gbit/s optical QPSK transmission system. Optimized phase shift proportional to intensity noise is given to the homodyne-detected electric field, leading to effective phase-noise reduction.

articleTitle: Optically-controlled beam forming technique for 60 GHz-ROF system using dispersion of optical fiber and DFWM
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present an optically-controlled beam forming technique that uses true-time-delay phase shift of millimeter-wave signals imposed by wavelength dispersion as they traverse the transmission fiber; DFWM multi-wavelength light source that uses HNLF is introduced.

articleTitle: WDM-PON with colorless ONUs
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: This paper describes the interest of operators for WDM PON and more particularly with colorless ONUs. Operator needs are presented and techniques to obtain colorless ONUs are reviewed.

articleTitle: A Novel Bias Control Technique for MZ Modulator with Monitoring Power of Backward Light for Advanced Modulation Formats
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose a novel high-sensitive and cost-effective bias control scheme for MZ modulator with minimizing monitored power of backward-traveling light, and demonstrate its effectiveness with the experiments of 10-Gbit/s CSRZ and 43-Gbit/s RZ-DQPSK signals.

articleTitle: Scheduling and Routing of Sliding Scheduled Lightpath Demands in WDM Optical Networks
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We develop a time conflict resolving window division algorithm which places a given set of sliding scheduled lightpath demands within their allowed interval and two routing and wavelength assignment (RWA) algorithms, and study their performance.

articleTitle: Field transmission by using a commercially-ready 43 Gbit/s DWDM system employing RZ-DQPSK transponders in high PMD installed fiber
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Using a commercially-ready 40-lambda DWDM system, RZ-DQPSK is confirmed to offer excellent DGD tolerance, up to 25 ps, through high PMD installed DSFs.

articleTitle: Zero Chirp 10 Gb/s MQW InP Mach-Zehnder Transmitter with Full-Band Tunability
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Zero chirp operation across C-Band is reported for a 10 Gb/s zero-chirp MQW InP Mach-Zehnder modulator. The optimized design ensures low residual chirp over all wavelengths, confirmed by symmetric OSNR penalty measurements.

articleTitle: QoS-aware RWA algorithms for path-protected DWDM networks
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We investigate novel RWA algorithms in the context of all-optical networks with various path protection schemes. Our algorithms exhibit low blocking probabilities and are less computationally intensive than previously proposed algorithms.

articleTitle: Survivable Differential Delay Aware Multi-Service Over SONET/SDH Networks with Virtual Concatenation
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose a model for differential-delay compensation and two approaches for provisioning survivable service on Data-over-SONET/SDH networks with virtual concatenation. Our approaches optimize the resource subject to the constraint of differential-delay compensation.

articleTitle: Demonstration and Design of High Spectral Efficiency 4Gb/s OFDM System in Passive Optical Networks
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: With OFDM's spectral efficiency and electrical signal processing power, we have demonstrated that a 4Gb/s OFDM-16QAM signal can be transmitted error free in 20km passive optical networks using cost-effective optical devices.

articleTitle: Practical Considerations for the Application of Highly Nonlinear Fibers
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Comparison of recent reported highly nonlinear fibers is carried out with viewpoints of practical use. Currently, silica-based highly nonlinear fibers are concluded to be most promising, and their recent progress is briefly reviewed.

articleTitle: Cross Layer Routing in Transparent Optical Networks
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: New algorithmically simplified WRA that incorporate physical layer criteria in the path establishment procedure are suggested and applied in the Deutsche-Telecom network. Their blocking performance superiority and physical performance guarantee are discussed.

articleTitle: Simultaneous and Independent Monitoring of OSNR, Chromatic and Polarization Mode Dispersion for NRZ-OOK, DPSK and Duobinary
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate experimentally and through simulations a simultaneous and independent monitoring of CD, PMD and OSNR using a ¼-bit delay Mach-Zehnder interferometer for NRZ-OOK, DPSK and Duobinary modulation formats.

articleTitle: Orthogonal-Frequency-Division Multiplexing for Optical Dispersion Compensation
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Orthogonal frequency division multiplexing offers an attractive method of electronically compensating for single-mode and multipath dispersion in optical links and optically-switched networks. This paper reviews recent progress in optical OFDM systems.

articleTitle: Data Center and High Performance Computing Interconnects for 100 Gb/s and Beyond
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We review architectures enabling >100 Gb/s interconnects in data centers. Parallel optical interconnects are cost effective for rack to rack interconnects. On-board optical waveguides offer data rate scalability, density and performance advantages over electrical interconnects.

articleTitle: Experimental Validation of an Access Evolution Strategy: Smooth FTTP Service Migration Path
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We examine a cost-effective upgrade path using WDM over deployed FTTP infrastructures with capability to co-exist with a working G-PON system. We demonstrate overlay of five Gigabit signals operating between 1531nm~1611lnm over a working G-PON.

articleTitle: Asynchronous Sampling for Optical Performance Monitoring
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present two novel performance monitoring techniques for optically switched networks, based on asynchronous multi-tap sampling. We show that multiple simultaneous impairments can be separated and quantified by a single monitor.

articleTitle: Tutorial Electronic Dispersion Compensation
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The article reviews the Powerpoint presentation on electronic dispersion compensation. The article summarises electronic distortion equalization, DSP equalization, CD mitigation, MLSE, maximum likelihood sequence estimator, Viterbi equalizer, DQPSK, optical orthogonal frequency division multiplexing, OFDM, narrow spectral filtering and fiber non-linearity.

articleTitle: 10.7 Gb/s Over 300 m GI-MMF Using a 2 × 2 MIMO System Based on Mode Group Diversity Multiplexing
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We investigate experimentally the feasibility of a 2x2 MIMO system based on mode group diversity multiplexing to enlarge the bandwidth distance product of MMF. A data rate of 10.7Gb/s over 300m GI-MMF is achieved.

articleTitle: Experimental Measurements of the Effectiveness of MLSE against Narrowband Optical Filtering Distortion
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We experimentally investigate the application of MLSE-EDC to signals transmitted through narrowband optical filters. We find MLSE affords significant OSNR improvement of ~5 dB for NRZ signals, but less or none for duobinary and DPSK.

articleTitle: 3.5-THz Wide, 175 Mode Optical Comb Source
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A stable 3.5-THz wide (175 modes times 20 GHz) optical comb source with nearly flat spectral phase is demonstrated. Adjustable mode spacing and wavelength tunability across the C-band are maintained.

articleTitle: Transmission of 10-Gb/s and 40-Gb/s Signals over 3.7 km of Multimode Fiber using Mode-Field Matched Center Launching Technique
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate the transmission of 10-Gb/s and 40-Gb/s signals over 3.7 km of multimode fiber by using the mode-field matched center launching technique.

articleTitle: Reduced-Complexity Decoding Algorithm for LDPC Codes for Practical Circuit Implementation in Optical Communications
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: For superior, practical decoding of LDPC based FEC, a cyclic approximated delta-minimum algorithm is proposed. Simulation shows that 3-bit soft-decision decoding provides a required Q of 6.2 dB at 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-6</sup> BER with only 16 iterations.

articleTitle: A Fully Functional Application-aware Optical Burst Switched Network Test-bed
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: This paper presents an application-aware asynchronous optical burst switched network demonstrator. Fully functional edge and core routers as well as a novel resource discovery signalling protocol is being demonstrated.

articleTitle: Experimental Demonstration of Transmission of Coherent Optical OFDM Systems
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We show the first experimental demonstration of coherent optical OFDM systems (CO- OFDM). 128 OFDM subcarriers with nominal data-rate of 8 Gb/s are successfully processed and recovered after 1000-km transmission through SSMF fibre without dispersion compensation.

Index Terms: Coherent Optical Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing

articleTitle: DPSK Receiver Design - Optical Filtering Considerations
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We study via simulation the influence of the DPSK decoder free spectral range (FSR) when strong optical filtering is considered for the NRZ and RZ modulation formats and show that larger FSR can improve performance.

articleTitle: Broadcast Transmission in WDM-PON using a Broadband Light Source
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A novel method to broadcast a video stream to all subscribers in WDM-PON is proposed and experimentally implemented. Using a broadband light source, we have achieved successful transmission performance with our proposed method.

articleTitle: Power Efficient LDPC-Coded Modulation for Free-Space Optical Communication over the Atmospheric Turbulence Channel
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We describe a power efficient transmission scheme based on LDPC-coded modulation. This technique is suitable for use in hybrid RF/microwave-free-space optical communications operating under the strong atmospheric turbulence, and provides an excellent coding gain.

articleTitle: All-optical wavelength conversion and multicasting by cross-gain modulation in a single-stage fiber optical parametric amplifier
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We have demonstrated an all-optical wavelength conversion and multicasting for a 10 Gb/s NRZ system with 100GHz channel spacing by using a single-stage two-pump fiber optical parametric amplifier (OPA) with the conversion gain of at least 15dB.

articleTitle: Robust, Low Cost, In-Band Optical Signal to Noise Monitoring Using Polarization Diversity
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a robust in-band OSNR monitor using polarization diversity and low-cost opto-electronics. The proposed technique offers relaxed manufacturing tolerances and is insensitive to extinction ratio, bit rate, chromatic dispersion and first order PMD.

articleTitle: Advances in Liquid Crystal on Silicon Wavelength Selective Switching
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Liquid crystal on silicon (LCOS) is employed as the active switching element for wavelength routing and attenuation in a wavelength selective switch. Additional functionalities such as power sharing, monitoring and channel contouring are able to be demonstrated simply and cost effectively.

articleTitle: All-Optical Multi-Wavelength Conversion with Negative Power Penalty by a Commercial SOA-MZI for WDM Wavelength Multicast
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: WDM wavelength multicast is demonstrated by all-optical multi-wavelength conversion at 10 Gb/s using a commercial SOA-MZI. We report for the first time simultaneous one-to-four conversion with negative power penalty of 1.84 dB.

articleTitle: Multiple Path Computation Element (PCE) Cooperation for Multi-layer Traffic Engineering
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The inefficiencies that affect current PCE cooperation based on PCE communication protocol (PCEP) in multi-layer networks are presented. A vertical approach is proposed to guarantee effective TE solutions while limiting the amount of exchanged information.

Index Terms: Pairs Of Nodes In The Network

articleTitle: Wavelength shifting for colorless ONUs in single-fiber WDM-PONs
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: With the purpose of reducing the crosstalk caused by Rayleigh backscattering in bidirectional centralized light systems, we propose a reflective ONU design that performs wavelength shifting by means of combined phase and SSB modulation.

articleTitle: Optical VPN Connecting ONUs in Different PONs
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate optical-layer virtual private networking in a new super-PON architecture using a dynamic wavelength reflector. The optical VPN enables communications among different PONs.

articleTitle: Application of Liquid Crystal Technology to Telecommunication Devices
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Using the wavelength selective switch as a prototypical example, we examine the use of liquid crystal technology for telecom applications. Some key design issues and performance parameters are discussed.

articleTitle: Optical Transceiver employing an RSOA with Feed-Forward Current Injection
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose an optical transceiver employing an RSOA of which gain is controlled by feed-forward current. With a low injection power below the gain saturation, the improved remodulation is clearly demonstrated at 1.25-Gb/s data rate.

articleTitle: 42.8 Gbit/s, 4 Bits per Symbol 16-ary Inverse-RZ-QASK-DQPSK Transmission Experiment without Polmux
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present an experimental implementation of 16-ary 42.8 Gbit/s Inverse-RZ-QASK- DQPSK, using four-level inverse return-to-zero amplitude modulation with four-level differential phase modulation. We demonstrate transmission over a 75 km fibre span with only minor degradation. copy2006 Optical Society of America

articleTitle: Dual-Wavelength Brillouin Fiber Laser for Microwave Frequency Generation
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate generation of RF/microwave frequencies using a dual-wavelength Brillouin fiber laser. We propose this device as a potential source of low phase noise, tunable frequencies into the millimeter wave regime compatible with RF-photonic systems.

articleTitle: A Novel Re-modulation Scheme to Achieve Colorless High-Speed WDM-PON with Enhanced Tolerance to Chromatic Dispersion and Re-modulation Misalignment
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose a novel re-modulation scheme using downstream OOK and upstream DPSK. A 30-km-range colorless WDM-PON without dispersion compensation and re-modulation synchronization was demonstrated within 1-dB penalty for both 10-Gbit/s downstream and 10-Gbit/s upstream signals.

articleTitle: Experimental Demonstration of Optically Phase-Shifted SSB Modulation with Fiber-Based Optical Hilbert Transformers
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Optically phase-shifted SSB modulation is demonstrated using the third-order optical Hilbert transformer of Mach-Zehnder interferometers. The results verify the principle of the optically phase-shifted SSB scheme which is applicable for high-speed transmission with bandwidth efficiency.

articleTitle: Moving Towards Upgradeable All-Optical Networks through Impairment-aware RWA Algorithms
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose an impairment-aware RWA algorithm that allocates a lightpath for services with different interface requirements at 10 Gb/s and 40 Gb/s across a common transparent optical network. Significant benefits are demonstrated when compared with existing techniques.

articleTitle: WDM Passive Optical Network with Parallel Signal Detection for Video and Data Delivery
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a novel WDM passive optical network (WDM-PON), which delivers data as well as video services to the end users through the employment of subcarrier modulation at the optical line terminal (OLT) and parallel signal detection (PSD) at the optical network unit (ONU). Experimental results show that the proposed WDM-PON is capable of providing triple play services in the access network.

articleTitle: Recent progress on FBG-based tunable dispersion compensators for 40 Gb/s applications
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The optical performance of state-of-the-art FBG-based tunable dispersion compensators is given in view of the recent advances. Results are given for a 33-channel device with 80 GHz bandwidth, 200 GHz channel spacing and tunable from -400 to +400 ps/nm, and for a 51-channel device with 40 GHz bandwidth, 100 GHz channel spacing and tunable from -600 to +600 ps/nm.

articleTitle: Demonstration of a Novel WDM-PON Access Network Compatible with ROF System to Provide 2.5Gb/s per Channel Symmetric Data Services
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present the first demonstration of an agile WDM-PON architecture compatible with radio-over-fiber system to provide 2.5Gbit/s symmetric data services. Several enabling techniques are employed to increase transmission capacity while keeping low cost.

articleTitle: All-optical Amplitude Noise Suppression of 160-Gb/s OOK and DPSK Data Signals Using a Parametric Fiber Switch
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate the noise limiting performance of a fiber switch based on parametric gain saturation in highly nonlinear fiber. Bit-error-rate measurements were performed at 160 Gb/s for on-off keying (OOK) and differential phase shift keying (DPSK) data signals.

articleTitle: Meeting SLAs by Design: a Protection Scheme with Memory
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A protection scheme is introduced that insures connections meet their SLAs with limited protection bandwidth. The network keeps track of the amount of outage each connection experiences, and protects them before they violate their SLAs.

articleTitle: Electronic Dispersion Compensation Based on Optical Field Reconstruction with Orthogonal Differential Direct-Detection and Digital Signal Processing
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present a receiver-side electronic dispersion compensation scheme based on optical field reconstruction using orthogonal differential direct-detection and DSP. Dispersion compensations for 20-Gb/s DQPSK and 10-Gb/s OOK signals over 2000-km SSMF transmission are numerically demonstrated.

articleTitle: Optical Cross Connects Architecture with per-Node Add&Drop Functionality
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose a cost-effective implementation of reconfigurable add&drop functionality in Optical Cross Connects based on the concept of common add&drop in the node (OXC with per- Node Add&Drop, OXC-NAD). The proposed architecture constrains usable transponders wavelengths, but the analysis on significant mesh topologies demonstrates that this does not affect the behavior of the transparent networks. The OXC-NAD is shown to also significantly reduce the node cost irrespective of the nodal degree.

articleTitle: Ultimate Linewidth-Tolerant 20-Gbps QPSK-Homodyne Transmission using a Spectrum-Sliced ASE Light Source
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrated ultimate linewidth-tolerant 20-Gbps QPSK-homodyne using a 3-nm spectrum-sliced ASE light source by an optical phase noise cancellation, attained BER less than 1 times 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-6</sup> after 160-km transmission. We also characterized DGD and dispersion tolerances.

articleTitle: Next Generation Optical Network - Enabling Dynamic Bandwidth Services
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Optical transport networks are transitioning to an intelligent next-generation optical transport network (NG-OTN) to improve operational efficiency, deploy more cost-effective optical transport, and enable dynamic bandwidth services.

articleTitle: Hybrid Dual-fiber-Ring with Single-fiber-Trees Dense Access Network Architecture using RSOA-ONU
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A long-reach, high-density centralized-light access network using remote amplification and Reflective SOA for upstream remodulation in a user-single-fiber completely passive WDM-PON providing broadband to >1000 users distributed along large distances is presented.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of a Network Node Management System for a Large-Scale ASON Test-Bed
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: This paper presents the node management system of a large-scale ASON test-bed constructed by Tsinghua University. This developed system was successfully demonstrated in terms of functions such as node operation and some basic network management.

articleTitle: Recent Research Activities of WDM-PON in Korea
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: WDM-PON is viewed as a suitable next generation access network technology due to its capability of delivering high bandwidth and OPEX saving features. In this paper, several research activities of DWDM-PON are introduced and analyzed. Technical issues and propects are also presented.

articleTitle: Measuring the Optical Signal-to-Noise Ratio in Agile Optical Networks
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We have proposed an improved OSNR measurement technique called optical polarization splitting based on the polarization-nulling method. The test results with Tellabs ultra high speed networks showed that the proposed technique could measure the OSNR accurately at all modulation formats even when the signal was significantly depolarized due to PMD and nonlinear birefringence.

articleTitle: Generalisation and Experimental Validation of Design Rules for Self-Phase Modulation-based 2R-Regenerators
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We report the design of 2R-regenerators based on self-phase modulation in lossy fibers. We experimentally demonstrate the applicability of the proposed scaling rules and present detailed characterization of the pulse characteristics at the regenerator output.

articleTitle: Adaptive PMD Compensation using OFDM in Long-Haul 10Gb/s DWDM Systems
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: In this paper, we show OFDM can adaptively compensate for large all-order PMD without requiring feedback. We demonstrate error-free transmission on a 1920km 40xlOGb/s DWDM link with 48ps mean DGD in presence of fiber nonlineariry.

articleTitle: 320 Gbit/s DQPSK All-Optical Wavelength Conversion using Four Wave Mixing
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: In this paper we demonstrate wavelength conversion of 320 Gbit/s DQPSK and 160 Gbit/s DPSK data signals by four wave mixing in highly nonlinear fibre. Error free operation is shown for conversion of both DPSK and DQPSK.

articleTitle: MARIN Hybrid Optical-Wireless Access Network
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A novel hybrid optical-wireless access network is proposed for metropolitan area. This novel architecture consists of wireless mesh networks and a reconfigurable optical backhaul and aggregation network based on TDM-PON technology.

articleTitle: A hybrid-amplified PON with 75-nm downstream band-width 60 km reach, 1:64 split, and multiple video services
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate an upgraded PON providing symmetric 2.488-Gb/s services and three downstream enhancement bands over 60 km to 64 customers. The system uses a SOA-Raman hybrid amplifier and a conventional SOA in an "extender box".

articleTitle: Design Optimization of Trench Index Profile for the same dispersion characteristics with SMF
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: An optimized design on a trench index profile for bend-insensitive SMF is presented. The same dispersion characteristic with standard SMF with ultra low bending loss has been realized by optimization of trench index profile.

articleTitle: Fully transparent multiplexing and transport of 10GbE-LANPHY signals in 44.6-Gbit/s-based RZ-DQPSK WDM transmission
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Abstract: We successfully demonstrate transparent 10GbE-LANPHY transport in 44.6-Gbit/s RZ-DQPSK WDM transmission for the first time. A single-chip 43/44-Gbit/s OTN framer LSI that supports fully transparent STM-64/10GbE multiplexing and DQPSK precoding are adopted.

articleTitle: Experimental Upstream Demonstration of a Long Reach Wavelength-Converting PON with DWDM Backhaul
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present experimentally a wavelength converting-PON which uses multiple PONs of similar specification to GPON, with wavelength conversion to provide 38.8 Mbit/s per user to potentially 1280 users over a distance of 120 km.

articleTitle: High-Sensitivity Demodulation of Multiple-Data-Rate WDM-DPSK Signals using a Single Interferometer
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate simultaneous reception of multiple-rate wavelength-division-multiplexed optical- DPSK signals using a single interferometer. The demodulation approach provides rate-flexibility and scalability, enabling penalty-free performance and compliance with existing channel-rate and channel-spacing standards.

articleTitle: 40Gbps links using plastic optical fiber
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate that plastic optical fiber can support 40 Gbps for short link lengths ~200 m links via DMD and impulse measurements. Further, we report BER and eye measurements for 10, 20 and 30 Gbps POF links confirming the DMD results.

articleTitle: Multi-Wavelength Laser Source for Dense Wavelength Division Multiplexing Networks
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose and demonstrate an ITU-T grid compatible DWDM laser source with 50 GHz channel spacing. It consists of a passively mode-locked laser, supercontinuum-generating photonic crystal fiber and fiber Fabry-Perot filter for spectral selection.

articleTitle: Electronic EDFA gain control for the suppression of transient gain dynamics in long-haul transmission systems
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: An electronic feedback gain control for the suppression of transients in EDFA chains is analyzed. It is shown that the optimal parameters for a single amplifier do not lead to optimal results for cascaded EDFAs.

articleTitle: A High-Efficiency Ytterbium-Doped Fiber Amplifier Designed for Interplanetary Laser Communications
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Design, performance, and environmental screening of flight prototype Ytterbium amplifiers designed for the Mars Laser Communications Demonstration are described. The high-reliability design delivered >8-W average power with low-duty-cycle PPM waveforms and >21% electrical-to-optical conversion efficiency.

articleTitle: Monitors to Ensure the Performance of Photonic Networks
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: As optical networks become more transparent, it becomes increasingly difficult to monitor the integrity of signals within the network. Fortunately, techniques used to improve capacity and reach can often be used to enhance performance monitoring.

articleTitle: EPON Deployment Challenges - Now and in the Future
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Even as several Asian telcos role out EPON en mass, they and other telcos are grappling with a number of challenges that effect their present and future deployments. This paper identifies and examines these challenges.

articleTitle: Multi-Fiber, MT Ferrule Endface Fiber Tip Displacement Model for Physical Contact Interconnects
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: This paper describes a simplified model linking MT ferrule and connector attributes to positive contact performance. Validation with FEA, experimental apparatus and empirical results are described, along with topics for future study.

articleTitle: PMD Compensation using Electronic Equalization particular Maximum Likelihood Sequence Estimation
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We review the basic electronic equalization techniques. We report new results of MLSE equalizers for combined chromatic dispersion and PMD. We show first results on the dynamic channel tracking performance of MLSE equalizers for PMD.

articleTitle: A Four-Channel, 10 Gbps Monolithic Optical Receiver In 130nm CMOS With Integrated Ge Waveguide Photodetectors
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: we introduce the world's first multi-channel, high-speed optical receiver using Ge waveguide photodetectors monolithically integrated in the CMOS process. The integrated receivers achieves a sensitivity of -14.2dBm (10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-12</sup> BER) at 10Gbps and 1550nm.

articleTitle: 1.92G bit/s MB-OFDM Ultra Wide Band Radio Transmission over Low Bandwidth Multimode Fiber
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate the feasibility of using low bandwidth multimode fiber to transmit 3x640Mbit/s MB-OFDM UWB radio signals with pre-distortion over a distance of 500 m by means of a low cost VCSEL.

articleTitle: Compensating Multimode Fiber Dispersion Using Adaptive Optics
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: In multimode fiber (MMF), principal modes are free of modal dispersion to first order. Using adaptive optics for controlled excitation of principal modes enables transmission far beyond the traditional bandwidth × length product. This technique scales much better than electrical equalization to multiple WDM channels, high bit rates and long fibers. We have demonstrated 10 Gbit/s NRZ transmission through 11 km of standard 50 μm graded-index MMF.

articleTitle: Serial 107Gbit/s ETDM NRZ Transmission over 320km SSMF
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We report on a complete serial 107 Gbit/s ETDM NRZ transmission system and assess system performance in an error free transmission experiment over 320 km SSMF with 3.5 dB OSNR margin.

articleTitle: Compact, Low-Loss Waveguide Crossings for High-Index-Contrast SOI Photonic Wires
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Waveguide crossings are essential for complex photonic circuits. We present compact crossings for silicon-on-insulator photonic wires. By locally applying a lower index contrast, 97.5% transmission is achieved in a 6μm length with only -40dB crosstalk.

articleTitle: All-Optical Combination of DPSK and OOK to 160 Gbit/s DQPSK Data Signals
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: All-optical combination of a DPSK and an OOK data signal to 160 Gbit/s DQPSK is proposed and demonstrated using highly nonlinear fiber. Error-free operation of the combiner is shown mid-span in a 320 km transmission link.

articleTitle: Towards a Cryptanalysis of Spectral-Phase Encoded Optical CDMA with Phase-Scrambling
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We show how an eavesdropper with a small amount of knowledge about the traffic sent via a spectral-phase optical CDMA system with phase-scrambling can break the confidentially of certain systems within a few bit intervals.

articleTitle: A New Dispersion Map for Undersea Optical Communication Systems
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present a new type of dispersion map for undersea WDM transmission based on non slope-matched fiber. 64x10 Gb/s were transmitted over transatlantic distance with more than 1.5 dB performance advantage over previous conventional maps.

articleTitle: Dynamic traffic grooming of subwavelength connections with known duration
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: For dynamic grooming of sub-wavelength connections in an optical mesh network, we investigate a new algorithm which exploits the holding time of connections to achieve significant reduction in blocking probability.

articleTitle: IMDD Transmission over 1,040 km of Standard Single-Mode Fiber at 10Gbit/s using a One-Sample-per-Bit Reduced-Complexity MLSE Receiver
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate 1,040km NRZ-IMDD transmission at 10Gbit/s over G.652 fibre, without any optical dispersion compensation, using a reduced-complexity MLSE receiver employing, for the first time at this distance, one sample per bit only.

articleTitle: Silica bridge impact on hollow-core Bragg fiber transmission properties
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The silica bridges impact on the hollow-core Bragg fiber guiding properties is investigated. Results demonstrate that silica nanosupports are responsible for the surface mode presence, which causes the peaks experimentally measured in the transmission spectrum.

articleTitle: Cost-effective 10.7-Gbit/s Long-Haul Transmission using Fiber Bragg Gratings for In-line Dispersion Compensation
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We show the feasibility of more cost-effective long-haul transmission using fiber Bragg gratings (FBG) for in-line dispersion compensation. 32xl0.7-Gbit/s NRZ modulated channels are transmitted over 40x95 km of SSMF using low group delay ripple FBGs.

articleTitle: Improving Access Performance with an Integrated PON and WiMAX with MIMO
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose and evaluate a near-optimal antenna allocation approach for a PON+WiMAX network with MIMO that takes advantage of the optical wireless integration to achieve a high throughput and good resilience.

articleTitle: Fault Location for Branched Optical Fiber Networks based on OFDR Technique Using FSF Laser as Light Source
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A new fault location method for passive branched optical fiber networks is proposed, which bases on OFDR technique using FSF laser source, and the fault in fiber branches are located according to the heterodyne detection.

articleTitle: Wavelength Selective Switches Based on Grating Assisted Mode Coupling
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A novel grating-assisted wavelength selective switch (WSS) is proposed. Its operating principle is experimentally confirmed with strong coupling strength, negligible birefringence, and low channel crosstalk. A WSS-based cross-connect device is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Backup Path Multiplexing over Survivable GMPLS Networks
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: This paper proposes a backup path multiplexing scheme for survivable generalized multiprotocol label switching (GMPLS) networks. The shared risk link group (SRLG)-disjoint label switched paths (LSPs) share common backup resources as many as possible to achieve higher efficiency. Based on the problem formulation, the analysis on the expected recovery failure probability, the expected recovery time, and the expected signal loss reveals the upper bound of the backup path length. The simulation results demonstrate that the proposed scheme provides higher multiplexing gain.

articleTitle: Simply-Structured Optical Terminators using Adhesive Polymer for Fiber Contact
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We have investigated a simple structure for optical terminators. By tuning the refractive index of an adhesive polymer for fiber end contact, high return losses over 50 dB with SPC connectors have been obtained.

articleTitle: Elmination of Manual Cleaving and De-nubbing in the Polishing of Connectorized Fiber End-faces
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate an automated process for connectorized optical fibers encompassing tip de-nubbing through final polish. The automated process is compatible with both single and multi-fiber connectors, and compliant to applicable optical and end-face geometry criteria.

articleTitle: 124 × 10 Gbit/s RZ-DPSK Transmission over 12380 km without Channelized Chromatic Dispersion Management
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We report transmission results of 124 RZ-DPSK channels modulated at 10.709 Gbit/s over 12380 km without channel chromatic dispersion management and we demonstrate industrial performance margins for Terabit/s systems over transpacific distances.

articleTitle: Network Upgrade from Telecom Operators View
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: This paper looks into some possible upgrade strategies for network upgrade from a telecom operators point of view taking into account infrastructure conditions.

articleTitle: Characterization of Cladding Modes for the Design of Long-Period Fiber Gratings
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose a method to measure the dispersion characteristics of the cladding modes of a single-mode fiber for the design of long-period gratings. The phase-matching curves for the first 19 symmetric cladding modes are obtained.

articleTitle: All-Optical Serial Multicast Mode and Experiment
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A novel all-optical serial multicast mode is proposed and experimentally researched in this paper. It can implement the storage, duplication, and serial export of the optical multicast packets and increase the multicast success ratio.

articleTitle: Light generation beyond a continuum edge using a fiber Bragg grating
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We generate light beyond the short wavelength edge of an optical continuum in highly nonlinear fiber pumped by an Er femtosecond laser, with a Bragg grating as a phase matching element.

articleTitle: Optics and the Challenge of Carrier Network Transformation
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The transformation of network architecture towards a multi-service packet network is explained and the dependencies between new optical technologies and network architectures are discussed.

articleTitle: Integrated photonic decoder with complementary code processing and balanced detection for two-dimensional OCDMA
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose a novel integrated-photonic decoder for two-dimensional (time/wavelength) OCDMA, which processes complementary codes and utilizes balanced detection to reduce unwanted cross-correlation interference. We successfully carried out a 10 Gbit/s transmission that demonstrated its effectiveness.

articleTitle: Coherence Free All Optical Microwave Notch Filter with Negative Coefficient Based on Polarization Modulation in an Electro-optic Phase Modulator
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose a coherence-free all-optical microwave notch filter with negative and positive coefficients from single optical source based on polarization modulation. The experimental result shows the stable notch filter characteristics with FSR of 3.97 GHz.

articleTitle: Transmission Performance Evaluation of 43Gb/s RZ-DPSK Transponder using Electrical Equalizer
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We have experimentally confirmed that 43Gb/s RZ-DPSK transponder using electrical equalizer could provide good transmission performances for various applications. By optimizing the equalizer setting, it suppressed the main degradation factor effect in each system application.

articleTitle: Adaptive Optical Compensation with Twin Fiber Gratings for First and Second Order PMD
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Twin tunable chirped-fiber gratings and a DOP monitoring scheme provide adaptive PMD compensation for 40-Gbps RZ-DQPSK signals. We show quantitatively the compensation scheme improves the PMD tolerance, but its effect is limited by second-order PMD.

articleTitle: A cmos photonics based 10Gbps fiber optic communication link
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A 10Gbps fiber optic communication link using CMOS photonics is analyzed and demonstrated to be feasible as a low cost, low power, highly integrated solution for next generation networks. The optical transceviever uses a 0.13μm SOI process to implement an integrated TX and RX module capable of driving greater than 2km of Single Mode (SM) fiber. The optical transceiver core operates at 10Gbps with a BER of less than 10exp-15 and a power consumption of 1.25W per channel.

articleTitle: Four-Wave Mixing Compensator based on Highly Nonlinear Fiber
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a new FWM compensation technique by using a highly nonlinear fiber and a pump laser. The results show that proposed technique could effectively suppress the FWM crosstalk generated in the transmission fiber and improve the system's performance.

articleTitle: Ultrafast wavelength-swept lasers
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Recent advances in swept lasers with scan speeds >1000 nm/ms, repetition rates >20 kHz, and tuning ranges >50 nm, primarily driven by new applications, are discussed.

articleTitle: High-power stable single-frequency waveguide laser
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a waveguide laser providing over 20 mW in robust single-frequency operation using a 9-mm-long active waveguide. Overall cavity length is <60 mm including butt-coupled fiber-Bragg-grating mirrors. Power scaling to 100 mW is discussed.

articleTitle: Electronic Equalization for Optical Communication
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference

articleTitle: Enhancement of the Stimulated Brillouin Scattering of Higher-Order Acoustic Modes in Hole-Assisted Fibers
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: By using an accurate numerical method we show that both the higher-order peaks and main peak of the SBS in hole-assisted-fibers can be enhanced by more than 3-dB, by appropriate selection of the design parameters.

articleTitle: Bandwidth Enhanced Multimode Fiber with Multi-singlemode Cores
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: By designing multi-cores across the fiber core area, the fiber only supports fundamental mode or fewer modes propagation. Therefore, the modal dispersion of the fiber has been suppressed and the bandwidth is greatly enhanced.

articleTitle: Photonic Crystal Everywhere Artificial Crystals Enable Diverse Key Functions
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Patterned 3D photonic crystals are fabricated by autocloning, a unique process for film deposition. A number of novel devices/systems are realized. Applications to polarization imaging, fiber optic SOP monitor, biophotonics, and pickup for multilayer DVD are reviewed.

articleTitle: Programmable Polarization-Independent Electrooptically Matched Bandpass Filter in Ti:LiNbO3
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A polarization-independent two-port electro-optically tunable bandpass filter with programmable spectral output in the 1530 nm wavelength regime with nearest side lobes -20 dB, 10 nm tuning range, and maximum required voltage 31.5 V is presented.

articleTitle: Fiber Parametric Amplifiers: Physics and Applications
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A collection of slides from the authors' conference presentation is given.

articleTitle: Compact 2×2 Couplers for unequal Splitting of Power obtained by Cascading of Short MMI Sections
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: More than 32% length reduction for 0%, 15%, and 28% cross-coupling multimode-interference couplers is obtained by cascading two short MMI sections. Previously unavailable cross coupling ratios of 7% and 64% are also obtained.

articleTitle: A Novel Two-Section Tunable Slotted Fabry-Pérot Laser Exhibiting ns Wavelength Switching
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A novel two-section tunable laser diode is demonstrated by etching slots into the laser ridge. A discontinuous tuning-range of 30 nm was achieved with a SMSR of 38 dB. A wavelength switching time of 1.5 ns is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Super-Broadband Access Services Delivery in Optical-Wireless Networks
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate the overall architecture design for delivering future super-broadband (>1 Gb/s) wired and wireless services over optical fiber network. Several enabling technologies for system integration and transmission of optical mm-wave over both fiber and air are discussed.

articleTitle: Large-mode-area single-mode holey fiber with low bending losses: Towards high power beam delivery systems
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose a novel design method for large-mode-area single-mode holey fiber with effective mode area of 1400 μm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, small allowable bending radius of 5 cm, and good beam quality factor of 1.15 at 1.064-μm wavelength.

articleTitle: Third-Order Dispersion Role in Mode-Locked Regimes of Yb-Doped Fiber Lasers
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Novel features in the stretched-pulse and similariton-cubicon regimes of Yb-doped fiber laser are found by means of numerical simulations when a photonic band-gap fiber with strong third-order dispersion is used for dispersion compensation.

articleTitle: Evaluation of the performance of SCM-based access networks using the spectrally-sliced ASE from a semiconductor optical amplifier
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We report on the distribution of SCM signals using the spectrally-sliced Amplified Spontaneous Emission (ASE) from a SOA. Also, we have developed a model for the ASE, and have obtained good agreement with the measurements.

articleTitle: Quasi-Dynamic Network Design Considering Different Service Holding/Contract Terms
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present a quasi-dynamic multi-layered photonic network design algorithm that achieves cost-effective incremental network expansion to accommodate future broadband services. It is demonstrated that service holding/contract times are key parameters in developing cost-effective networks.

articleTitle: Fiber Optical Parametric Oscillator with 560 nm Tuning Range Using Dispersion-Shifted Fiber
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A fiber optical parametric oscillator based on modulation instability in the normal dispersion regime is described. A tuning range of over 560 nm with high conversion efficiencies has been experimentally achieved.

articleTitle: Turbulent Broadening of a Raman Fiber Laser Spectrum
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: An analytical wave kinetic theory has been developed that describes a Raman fiber laser (RFL) generation spectrum. A four-wave mixing between RFL longitudinal modes in turbulent regime is shown to be the main broadening mechanism.

articleTitle: All-Optical Wavelength Conversion in As2S3 Chalcogenide Glass Rib Waveguides
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We report the first demonstration of all-optical wavelength conversion in a 5 cm As<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> rib waveguide over 15 nm near 1550 nm via cross-phase modulation, at low repetition rates and 10 Gb/s RZ, while maintaining pulse amplitude and phase.

articleTitle: High-Speed Wavelength-Swept Semiconductor Laser Using a Diffraction Grating and a Polygon Scanner in Littrow Configuration
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: High-speed tuning of an extended-cavity semiconductor laser is demonstrated using a scanning polygon filter. We achieved a tuning rate of 7714-nm/ms with 65 mW of power over a wavelength range of 135-nm and with an instantaneous line-width ~ 0.13 nm.

articleTitle: Controllability of guided acoustic-wave Brillouin scattering spectra in hole-assisted fibers
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We clarify that GAWBS gain for a particular acoustic torsional/radial mode is observed in hole-assisted fiber. It is revealed that the acoustic mode can be controlled by simply designing the air-hole position and size.

articleTitle: Adaptive Split-Step Quasi-Spectral Finite Difference Method for Nonlinear Optical Pulse Propagation
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Combining a new semi-analytical step size estimation strategy with highly efficient quasi-spectral finite differences, a fast adaptive split-step solver for the nonlinear Schrodinger equation is presented. For large WDM systems, a substantial speed-up is obtained.

articleTitle: Nonlinear distortion free fiber-based chirped pulse amplification with self-phase modulation up to 2π
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: By using an electo-optic phase modulator to realize nonlinear phase pre-compensation, we demonstrate nonlinear distortion free fiber-based chirped pulse amplification with accumulated self-phase modulation up to 2.0 π radians.

articleTitle: New High-Speed Optical Routing Architecture Based on First-Come-First-Serve Principle
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose a new high-speed routing architecture based on the first-come-first-served principle with a partial-mesh topology. This architecture can solve the optimal-path problem and renew look-up tables within 200 ms over a 200-node network. The prototype boards implemented in the architecture showed high-speed performance.

articleTitle: Use of Remote Software Download to Improve Operation Efficiency of Next -Generation Optical Transport Networks (NG-OTN)
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: This paper presents the use of remote software download, upgrade, memory backup and restoration processes to improve operational efficiencies of NG-OTN. Network Element requirements, test results in a multi-vendor environment, and evolutionary considerations are presented.

articleTitle: Minimizing Vulnerability with End-to-End Protection Schemes for Optical Networks
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: In this paper, we present techniques that allow network end-to-end protection reconfiguration algorithms to achieve maximum robustness under multiple failures. With the presented approach, maximum robustness can be achieved for a given topology.

articleTitle: A Temporally Interleaved Technique for Simultaneously Measuring Diagnostic Spectral Parameters and Link Performance in Active Optically Amplified Systems
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present a novel measurement technique for spectral measurements of optically amplified systems that enables simultaneous measurement and therefore correlation of a diagnostic parameter and the performance of the link.

articleTitle: Optical Approach to Avionic Platforms Based on OCDMA
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We built scalable OCDMA platform under DARPA contract and delivered to Lockheed-Martin for additional testing. Demonstrated platform enables secure communications among users using an optical XOR gate at OC-24 with 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-12</sup> or better raw BER.

articleTitle: Polarized Saturable Absorbing Waveguide Using Carbon Nanotube-Polyimide Composite Material
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: In a waveguide using carbon nanotube-polyimide core we discovered polarized absorption probably due to the molecular alignment of nanotubes in the polyimide matrix. We observed efficient saturable absorption at the polarization along the molecular alignment.

articleTitle: Distribution of Embedded DWDM Channel Monitors in Pass-Through Node Limited Transmission Links
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A transmission model is used to derive the requirements for distributing DWDM optical channel monitors in transmission links engineered with ROADM-based architectures, which can require up to 24 transparent pass-through nodes. The model applies random settings of variable parameters to reflect realistic optical transmission link budgets. It is shown that as the number of spans increase, DWDM channel monitors must be distributed more frequently, approaching an economical "tipping point" that may justify integrating channel monitors within optical amplifiers.

articleTitle: Digitization of Microwave Signals with Spatial Spectral Holography
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A new optical approach to broadband analog-to-digital conversion is discussed, which directly records signals in the frequency domain. This frequency-domain stretch processor can achieve 10-bit performance at 20 GSPS and is extendable to signals over 100 GHz.

articleTitle: Wide Modulation Bandwidth VCSELs With Side Current Injection and Copper-Plated Heatsink
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We proposed and demonstrated a novel VCSEL structure for a wide direct modulation bandwidth. Additional current injection and heat sinking revealed the reduction of electrical and thermal resistances and achieved a modulation bandwidth of 16GHz.

articleTitle: Synchronous Clock Pumping to Improve Performance of All-optical Wavelength Conversion for RZ-DPSK Based on Four-Wave Mixing in SOA
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Synchronous clock pumping is proposed to improve the performance of all optical wavelength conversion based on four-wave mixing effect in semiconductor optical amplifier. About 3dB improvement in output power is achieved for RZ-DPSK format.

articleTitle: Centralized Resource Management in WSS-Based Wavelength Cross-Connect Nodes
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We analyze the applications of centralized resource management for transponder sharing and repeater assignment in wavelength selective switch based wavelength cross-connect nodes. We also propose a novel solution to realize centralized resource management.

articleTitle: Cerenkov radiation in optical fiber communication
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Theoretical predictions regarding the angular variation of Cerenkov radiation transmitted along optical fibers are experimentally verified. The implications for transmission in a radiation environment are considered.

articleTitle: Economic Evolution from EPON to WDM-overlaid PON Employing a Wavelength Conversion Node
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Cost-effective evolution architecture from EPON to WDM-overlaid PON is proposed. To maintain the colorless characteristics of ONUs, a wavelength-conversion node is employed. Appropriate structures for a remote node and a WCN are suggested and analyzed.

articleTitle: Cost vs. Capacity Tradeoff with Shared Mesh Protection in Optical-Bypass-Enabled Backbone Networks
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Shared mesh protection based on cross-connecting pre-deployed protection subconnections is well suited for the optical-bypass-enabled networks currently being deployed. This scheme poses a cost-versus-capacity tradeoff, which is investigated through studies on several realistic backbone networks.

articleTitle: SOA-based All-optical Processing
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A collection of slides from the author's conference presentation is given.

articleTitle: Network Planning and Architecture Analysis of Wavelength Blocking in Optical and Digital ROADM Networks
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Detailed network planning analysis indicates wavelength blocking in all-optical ROADM networks incurs additional OEO for wavelength conversion, and constrains service reconfiguration. Analyses show that digital ROADM systems mitigate these problems and may provide greater service flexibility.

articleTitle: Cost-Effective Optical Access Upgrades using Wavelength Shared Hybrid Passive Optical Network Architecture
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose and demonstrate a novel wavelength shared hybrid passive optical network (WS-HPON) architecture for symmetric gigabit PON capacity upgrades with installed equipment re-use, to bridge the technology gap between gigabit- and WDM-PON systems cost- effectively.

articleTitle: Applications of ROADMs and Control Planes in Metro and Regional Networks
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Reconfigurable Optical Add/Drop Multiplexers (ROADMs) and unified control planes are relevant features for next-generation optical transport networks. Where ROADM hardware will enable single-channel add/drop of any wavelength anywhere, the control plane and the related interfaces (GMPLS, OIF UNI, NNI) will lead to deep changes in network concepts, enabling direct in- terworking of the IP/MPLS and optical layers in order to control flexible components like ROADMs. This will lead to significant operational cost savings for future IP-minded networks. This paper discusses the relevant techniques, concepts, and applications of ROADMs and the unified control plane.

articleTitle: On Using Fast Signalling to Improve Restoration in Multilayer Networks
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present a fast signalling scheme where intra-layer signalling and inter-layer communication are used to reduce the recovery operation time. Simulation reveals the efficiency of the scheme compared to normal signalling strategies.

articleTitle: Diverse Delay-Constrained Restoration Schemes
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present a novel multi-constrains routing algorithm, called one-step delay-constrained pool sharing (ODPS) algorithm, in a survivable mesh network.
