The goal of this algorithm is to compute a pair of link-disjoint primary and backup paths between a given source and destination nodes, which guarantees full recovery from any single link failure in the network. Our objective is to minimize the total end-to-end delay time along the primary and backup paths as well as the resources (such as backup bandwidth) used in the network. Our approach solves the trap-topology issue of the two-step delay-constrained pool sharing (TDPS) algorithm which we introduced in our earlier contribution. Using simulation, we have studied both TDPS and ODPS algorithms on the existing North-American transport networks. We show that ODPS avoids trap-topology, and outperforms TDPS in terms of the total end-to-end packet delay.

articleTitle: Robust Timely Scheduled Optical Burst Switching
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The two-way reservation based optical-burst-switching scheme is implemented over existing distributed-control optical-circuit-switching networks through the novel robust timely scheduled reservation protocol to guarantee data delivery and minimize burst blocking while maximizing wavelength utilization.

articleTitle: Packet Transport OAM - Service Provider Alternatives
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: This paper compares the alternatives for MPLS OAM implementation. It describes the ways that Ethernet, MPLS, and other layer OAM tools can be used in network applications, and details the service management alternatives and tradeoffs.

articleTitle: OFC/NFOEC Table of contents
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Presents the table of contents of the proceedings.

articleTitle: Field Trial of Inter-domain Point-to-multipoint Connections in ASON Using Web Service Mechanism
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A field trial of dynamic P2MP connections across two domains was successfully achieved in the ASON layer of the 3TNet testbed in Yangtze River Delta, China for the first time using web service mechanism.

articleTitle: Electronic dispersion compensation in bandwidth limited 43 Gb/s PSBT systems for 50 GHz spaced DWDM application
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We studied electronic dispersion compensation in bandwidth limited PSBT systems for 50 GHz spaced DWDM application. Transmitter optimization in conjunction with Viterbi equalizer application enables 43 Gb/s data transmission in 30 GHz optical channels with 230 ps/nm CD and 18 ps DGD tolerance.

articleTitle: Security-Enhanced SPECTS O-CDMA Demonstration Across 150 km Field Fiber
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate security-enhanced, multi-user SPECTS O-CDMA transmission across 150 km of field fiber. The testbed incorporates a fully integrated silica AWG spectral phase encoder/decoder and tunable dispersion slope compensation. Error-free performance is achieved using FEC.

articleTitle: Electronic Dispersion Compensation of 40-Gb/s Multimode Fiber Links Using IIR Equalization
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Simulations demonstrate a 3rd order IIR equalizer compensates for modal dispersion in over 90% of the 5% worst-case 50-m multimode fiber links at 40Gbps with less than 2.5dB ISI penalty and 0.15 UI of jitter.

articleTitle: Robust Long-Haul Transmission Utilizing Electronic Precompensation and MLSE Equalization
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We assess the performance of transmission systems utilizing electronic predistortion and MLSE equalization. In 11-Gb/s transmission over 1040 km of standard fiber, the required accuracy of the EPD can be relaxed to +/-1400 ps/nm using an 8-state Viterbi algorithm.

articleTitle: A Non-Oxide 850 nm VCSEL for High-Speed Datacom Applications
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We have developed an 850nm VCSEL where current and photon confinement is achieved by a mesa structure without lateral oxidation. The VCSEL performance and reliability is discussed in the context of 4xFC and 10GbE applications.

articleTitle: All-Optical Wavelength Conversion at 40 Gb/s Data Rate in Silicon Waveguides
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We report efficient wavelength conversion of a high speed signal at 40 Gb/s via four-wave mixing in silicon-on-insulator rib waveguides. Results give an efficiency of -8.6 dB, and the converted signal shows good signal integrity.

articleTitle: Collectively Fabricated Spherical Lensed Fiber Array Based on Chemical Etching and Polishing Techniques
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A simple fabrication method for spherical lensed fiber array (SLFA) is developed. All fibers of SLFA are handled collectively through the etching and polishing processes. Far-field patterns were measured. Tip radii of curvature were 10±1μm.

articleTitle: PMD Outage Probabilities Revisited
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: In the time intervals of its validity, the new hinge model for optical fiber transmission links requires a re-examination of the traditional concepts of PMD outage and their impact on system design. copy2007 Optical Society of America

articleTitle: Design and implementation of an Optical Dynamic Core Network - Engineering considerations
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: This paper will discuss issues and solutions associated with the design and implementation of "multi-degree ROADM-based" ring and mesh optical networks. Compensation methods used to combat the effects of chromatic dispersion, PMD, and ASE noise will be discussed in reference to both 10 and 40 Gbps systems. The presentation will step through the design of a complex mesh network that utilizes a combination of two-degree ROADMs, multi-degree ROADMs, EDFA amplifiers, Raman amplifiers, PMD compensators, and chromatic dispersion compensators.

articleTitle: FBG Based Distributed Lighting for Sensing Applications
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: An efficient distributed light source has been developed for line scan sensing. The source is based on diffracting light from a highly blazed grating written in the core of a single mode fiber.

articleTitle: In-Field WDM-DPSK 8×10 Gb/s Transmission over 300 km using Four Common SOAs
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Field-trial transmission demonstrates the feasibility of WDM-DPSK systems exploiting semiconductor optical amplifiers, with practical amplifier spacing (100 km) for the first time.

articleTitle: SPM-Based 2R Regenerative 10Gbps Optically Linearly Controlled Delay Line with 0ps to 170ps Tuning Range
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a 2R regenerative optical delay line with error-free operation, 1 dB negative sensitivity penalty for degraded 10 Gbps RZ packets. Its time delay can be linearly tuned from 0 ps to 170 ps with maintained original wavelength.

articleTitle: Temperature-Insensitive Silicon Nano-Wire Ring Resonator
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present a silicon nano-wire ring resonator with a temperature-dependent wavelength shift as low as 0.006 nm/degC by adjusting the mode volume of a SOl-based silicon waveguide covered with a polymeric material.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of Electronic Equalizers for Dynamic PMD Compensation in Systems with FEC
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Experimental investigations show that the dynamic performance of PMD compensation using electronic equalizers in systems with FEC is very different from the performance in the static case and in systems without FEC.

articleTitle: Digital Protection for Ethernet and Video Transport Oriented Metro Optical Networks
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We describe a digital protection scheme based on integrated sub-wavelength switching that is optimized for Ethernet and video-transport oriented metro optical networks. Results from a quantitative analysis illustrate the significant benefits over traditional protection methods.

articleTitle: Generation of multi-channel short-pulse sources using nonlinear optical loop mirror based on photonic crystal fiber
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Fourteen C+L-band synchronized multi-channel short pulse sources are generated based on XPM and FWM effects in nonlinear optical loop mirror. Walk-off effect is reduced effectively by using 10m high nonlinear dispersion flattened photonic crystal fiber.

articleTitle: Dispersion Compensation using All-Pass Digital IIR Filters
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The use of infinite impulse response filters to achieve chromatic dispersion compensation for homodyne phase-diversity detection systems employing digital signal processing is proposed. Theory, simulation and experimental results show the advantages of this approach.

articleTitle: Increasing the Number of Users in an Optical CDMA System by Pulse-Position Modulation
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We analytically show that using PPM-OCDMA can increase the spectral efficiency of an OCDMA system up to factor of 3. Utilizing our results we generate the performance trends of PPM-OCDMA systems for varying code-sets

articleTitle: 40 GHz actively mode-locked erbium-doped fiber ring laser using an electro-absorption modulator and a linear optical amplifier
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrated a 40-GHz actively mode-locked erbium-doped fiber laser that incorporates an electro-absorption modulator and a linear optical amplifier. Stable pulses with peak power of 46 mW and pulsewidth of 2.8 ps are obtained when pumped with 100 mw.

articleTitle: Long-distance and quasi-distributed FBG sensor system using a SOA based ring cavity scheme
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A simple long-distance and quasi-distributed FBG sensor system using a pulsed SOA is investigated. In the proposed system, OSNR greater than 20 dB from 6 FBGs quasi-distributed along a 40-km fiber was achieved.

articleTitle: 1.1W Four-Wavelength Raman Pump Using BH Lasers
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A new high-power 4-wavelength extended C-band Raman pump with 1.1W total fiber output power is demonstrated enabling 60nm Raman gain bandwidth (1.6dB ripple). High-power BH lasers are fabricated and fiber-coupled with high efficiency (0.8).

articleTitle: Suppression of WDM Signal Crosstalk in Fiber Optical Parametric Amplifier by using RZ-DPSK Modulation Format
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrated crosstalk-free WDM signal amplification by single-pump fiber OPA with RZ-DPSK modulation format. The power penalty of OPA amplified 20 Gb/s WDM RZ-DPSK signal was reduced by more than 2 dB as compared with OOK counterpart.

articleTitle: Proposal for Miniaturized Interleaver with Flat-Top Passbands Utilizing Coupled-Resonator Optical Waveguide Rings in Photonic Crystals
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The introduction of coupled-resonator optical waveguides to ring resonators in the IIR filter configuration enables a miniaturized interleaver with wide flat-top passbands. A wavelength-insensitive photonic crystal directional coupler with two decoupling points is also presented.

articleTitle: Pump-to-Stokes transfer of relative intensity noise in Brillouin fiber ring lasers
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Pump-to-Stokes RIN transfer function in Brillouin ring lasers is studied experimentally in frequency and time domain, indicating 40-60 dB RIN reduction at anti-resonant frequencies. At resonant frequencies the transfer function is still much lower than unity.

articleTitle: Design of Large Hollow-Core Photonic Band-Gap Fibers with Suppressed Higher-Order Modes
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present the suppression of higher-order modes in realistic large-hollow-core photonic band-gap fibers, free of surface modes, based on the index-matching mechanism of central air-core modes with defected outer-core modes for an effectively single-mode operation.

articleTitle: Optimizing Transport Systems to Integrate TDM and Packet Services
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Transport elements must evolve to seamlessly integrate TDM and packet services into a single platform. This integration is best achieved using a hybrid switch that is capable of switching both TDM and packet flows.

articleTitle: Adaptive Polarization Tracking and Equalization for Polarization-Diverse Intradyne Receiver of On-Off Keying (OOK)
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose using on-off-keying with an adaptive algorithm to resolve issues in coherent communication to track fast polarization without phase synchronization. This allows polarization-multiplexed transmission and compensation of impairments, making coherent detection feasible for implementation.

articleTitle: Measuring Contact Phenomenon in Multi-Fiber Optical Connectors
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A novel method to ascertain the gap between fibers in a connector is presented. This information in conjunction with applied load provides a useful tool for investigating positive contact, especially in connectors utilizing MT ferrules.

articleTitle: A FSR-Interleaved, Self-Wrapping, Multiple-Cascaded AWG-based WDM Access Network
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We describe a WDM:TDM-swapped access network architecture, featuring AWG-based double-cascade downstream and triple-cascade upstream operation. Cyclical Latin-routing protocols allow FSR-interleaving for capacity-multiplication via self-wrapping 16×16 and 1×32 central office AWGs. 2.5Gb/s/wavelength performance was experimentally verified.

articleTitle: A Novel Lensed Fiber with a Focused Spot Diameter as Small as the Wavelength
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A lensed fiber with a focused spot diameter as small as 1.6 μm at the wavelength 1.55 μm has been obtained. An aspherically-ended graded-index fiber chip coated with a high-index layer is employed.

articleTitle: Damage to optical networks by wildlife and methods for protecting existing optical fiber cables in the FTTH era
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: This paper describes a 1999-2005 analysis of damage to optical networks by wildlife and proposes methods for protecting existing optical fiber cables. These methods enable us to improve network reliability and reduce maintenance costs.

articleTitle: SBS slow light in optical fibers with 25-GHz-bandwidth
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Broadband slow light is demonstrated using stimulated Brillouin scattering in optical fibers based on double Brillouin pump. A 25-GHz bandwidth is achieved, resulting in a variable time delay up to 10.9 ps with 37-ps pulses.

articleTitle: 40 Gbit/s Double-Band DWDM Transmission Over 46 km PCF-DSF Transmission Line
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A wide-band transmission line is proposed using a PCF and DSF. The available bandwidth is quadrupled, and 40 Gbit/s DWDM signals have been transmitted over 46 km using the 1310 and 1550 nm bands simultaneously.

articleTitle: Ultra High Capacity WDM Photonic Integrated Circuits
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Design and performance of large scale, dense wavelength division multiplexed InP transmitter and receiver photonic integrated circuits (PICs) are reviewed. The PICs are capable of transmitting and receiving up to 40 wavelengths at data rates up to 40Gbit/s per channel.

articleTitle: Parabolic Pulse Generation through Passive Reshaping of Gaussian Pulses in a Normally Dispersive Fiber
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We numerically and experimentally demonstrate that a Gaussian pulse can be reshaped into a pulse with a stable parabolic intensity profile during propagation in normally dispersive nonlinear fibers.

articleTitle: Inline Pump Sharing Architecture for Remotely-Pumped Pre- and Post-Amplifiers
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A new transmission link configuration with remote Er post- and pre-amplifiers where pump power is shared between a pair of fibers carrying traffic in opposite directions is proposed. A budget increase of >4dB is demonstrated.

articleTitle: 40 Gb/s both inverted and non-inverted wavelength conversion based on transient XPM of SOA
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate 40 Gb/s inverted and non-inverted wavelength conversion (WC) in the whole C-band based on a SOA and an optical bandpass filter. The WC is non-inverted regardless if the filter is blue- or red-shifted with respect to the central wavelength of the converted signal.

articleTitle: Dynamic Attenuator - a New Passive Device to Control Optical Power Levels in Networks
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Dynamic attenuator, a new passive optical device limits output power level by light scattering mechanism and protects the network from permanent damage. This paper shows its assembly and performance under normal and extreme environmental conditions.

articleTitle: Optical Equalizer monolithically integrated with a Semiconductor Optical Amplifier
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present the first optical equalizer monolithically integrated with a semiconductor optical amplifier. We show that the device can mitigate the Inter-Symbol Interference arising from narrowband optical filtering on 40 Gb/s Non-Return to Zero data.

articleTitle: A Testbed for Multi-Granularity Optical Switching Network
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: This paper presents a novel testbed for multi-granularity optical switching network. All the related hardware and protocols are realized. The functions of the testbed are verified via experiment and numerical simulation.

articleTitle: Novel OSNR Monitoring Technique in Dense WDM Systems using Inherently Generated CW Monitoring Channels
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present a simple, yet effective OSNR monitoring technique based on an inherent effect in the optical modulator. Highly accurate OSNR monitoring is demonstrated in a 40 Gb/s dense WDM system with 50 GHz channel spacing.

articleTitle: OAM in Packet Transport Networks
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Networks are transitioning from TDM to packet transport optimized architectures. Packet networks are based on technologies traditionally lacking OAM tools. We will present the OAM tools being developed and their application to the transport layers.

articleTitle: IFWM Suppression in NRZ Transmission Experiment at 40 Gb/s Using Asynchronous Phase Modulation
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The asynchronous phase modulation (APM) scheme is experimentally studied for the first time. APM is shown to increase the power tolerance of NRZ-OOK over a 3x75-km link.

articleTitle: QoS Differentiation in OBT Ring Networks with Comparison to RPR Networks
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Optical burst transport networks employ burst transmission in WDM ring architectures and are promising candidates for MANs. We investigate QoS differentiation in OBT, and compare its performance to IEEE 802.17 resilient packet ring (RPR) standard.

articleTitle: Field Installable LC Connector and Mechanical Splice
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: This paper describes the development of the field installable LC connector and the mechanical splice. Both developments are an improvement over existing techniques in terms of operation, reliability and costs.

articleTitle: Dual-resonance frequency response in injection-locked 1.55 μm VCSELs
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: In this study, 1.55 μm VCSELs with slightly detuned polarisation modes are injection- locked with controlled polarisation angles. A dual-resonance frequency response is observed, and is explained with a two polarisation-mode injection-locked rate equation model.

articleTitle: S band erbium-doped fiber ring laser tunable through the active fiber bending losses
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A S band single-frequency depressed-cladding erbium-doped fiber ring laser which can be tuned through the active fiber bending losses is presented. A tuning range of 44 nm, between 1491 and 1535 nm, has been demonstrated.

articleTitle: Monolithically Integrated Multi-Stage All-Optical 10Gbps Push-Pull Wavelength Converter
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: This paper reports on the novel design and operation of a monolithically integrated multi-stage push-pull wavelength converter. Results show 4 dB improvement in extinction ratio and error-free performance for 10Gbps push-pull operation.

articleTitle: Do Quantum Dots or Quantum Wire Based Devices Offer a Practical Advantage in Producing Semiconductor Optical Amplifiers over Conventional 2-D Active Media
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Basic properties of nano-structure semiconductor gain media such as an inhomogeneously broadened gain, a fast response time, a low α-parameter and complex carrier dynamics yield amplifiers which are far superior to conventional quantum well amplifiers.

articleTitle: Mechanical strength and fatigue of microstructured optical fibers
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The response of the strength and fatigue parameters of strong microstructured fiber to environmental factors in holes was studied. It was similar to that for usual hole-free strong fibers without a protective coating.

articleTitle: Hybrid Silicon Evanescent Laser in a Silicon-on-Insulator Waveguide
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate electrically pumped silicon evanescent lasers operating cw at 40degC. Light is confined by SOI waveguides, and the evanescent tail is amplified by AlGalnAs quantum wells. This process is applicable to silicon-evanescent-photonic-integrated circuits.

articleTitle: Practical design of Microstructured Optical Fibers for Surface Plasmon Resonance sensing
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Plasmons on the surface of large metallized holes containing analyte are excited by the fundamental mode of a microstructured fiber. Phase matching between plasmon and core modes is facilitated by the perforation of fiber core.

articleTitle: 10 Gb/s transmitter-based equalization for extended-reach multimode-fiber datacommunication links
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Transmitter-based equalization is investigated for enhanced performance in 10 Gb/s multimode- fiber links. Rigorous simulations and proof-of-principle experiments over 500 m of FDDI-grade fiber confirm for the first time the potential superiority of the technique relative to receiver-based schemes.

articleTitle: Simultaneous Modulation and Transmission of FTTH Baseband and Radio Signals on a Single Wavelength
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose a hybrid optical access network integrating wired-line FTTH baseband and wireless RF signals sharing a single distributed infrastructure. After transmitted over 50km optical fiber, power penalties for both signals are less than 0.2dB.

articleTitle: Patterning of Errors in 40 Gbit/s WDM RZ-DBPSK SMF/DCF Optical Transmission System
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Through extensive direct modelling we quantify patterning effects in a WDM RZ-DBPSK fibre link at 40 Gbit/s channel rate. We demonstrate BER improvement through skewed channel pre-encoding reducing the occurrence of the most dangerous triplets.

articleTitle: Impact of Modulation Format on the Performance of Fiber Optic Communication Systems with Transmitter-Based Electronic Dispersion Compensation
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We analyze the performance of 10.7 Gb/s G.652 fiber optic systems with transmitter-based EDC and advanced modulation formats and find that RZ-type formats offer ~2 dBQ advantage over NRZ-type formats due to their broader spectrum.

articleTitle: Tunable Slow Light using Quantum Dot VCSEL for Subcarrier Multiplexed System
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate that the slow light device can be used in a SCM system for the first time. Tunable slow light can be achieved by adjusting the bias current and wavelength detuning of QD VCSEL.

articleTitle: Silicon Photonic Crystal Directional Couplers for Power Splitting, Wavelength Filtering, and Optical Switching
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: All optical switching has been demonstrated using photonic crystal directional couplers illuminated with a 10mW control signal. Power splitters and wavelength filters are also demonstrated with these 10×12 μm footprint devices.

articleTitle: Synchronized Coherent OCDM System using 128-chip Orthogonal Sequence SSFBG Encoder/Decoder
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Synchronized optical code division multiplexing system using 128-chip orthogonal sequence SSFBG en/decoder was experimentally demonstrated. Multiplexing for more than 17 users is experimentally demonstrated with changing interference levels using orthogonal codes for reducing cross-correlation noise.

articleTitle: Design and Experimental Demonstration of Novel Optical Router Controller Capable of Asynchronous, Variable-Length Packet Switching and Contention Resolution
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: This paper proposes the efficient design and implementation of a hierarchical optical router controller supporting asynchronous, variable-length optical packets. A network testbed experiment demonstrates very effective switching and contention resolution of asynchronous, variable-length optical packets.

articleTitle: Advances in 40G electronic equalizers
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Progress in LSI technologies and circuit techniques has led to 40-Gbit/s electronic equalizers. A new InP-HBT decision-feedback-equalizer IC using a circuit technique that boosts speed exhibits good performance at 40 Gbit/s.

articleTitle: 2.5-Tb/s (256 × 12.4 Gb/s) Transmission of 12.5-GHz-Spaced Ultra-dense WDM Channels over a Standard Single-Mode Fiber of 2000 km
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present a 2.5-Tb/s transmission of 12.5-GHz-spaced ultra-dense WDM channels over a standard SMF of 2000 km. The channels are NRZ modulated and only C-band EDFAs are used with the repeater spacing of 100 km.

articleTitle: Network Performance Evaluation of End-to-End Application over SPECTS O-CDMA Testbed
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: This paper experimentally demonstrates end-to-end applications over a SPECTS O- CDMA network including edge routers and end hosts. We measure the 2times2 network performance running video streaming and FTP applications.

articleTitle: SBS Slow Light in High Nonlinearity Photonic Crystal Fiber
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Up to 14-ns delay is achieved by the SBS slow light in a 25-m long high nonlinearity photonic crystal fiber. The high delay efficiency improves the control rate of SBS slow light systems.

articleTitle: Security Enhanced OCDMA System Based on Incoherent Broadband Light Source and Bipolar Coding
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We proposed and experimentally demonstrate security enhanced OCDMA scheme using incoherent broadband light source and bipolar coding. To guarantee successful transmission of OCDMA signal and to prevent eavesdropping simultaneously for an authorized user, we also present analytical results.

articleTitle: Evolutionary Optical Access Network: Port-share based Scalable WDM based Ethernet PON
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Proposed scalable WDM based Ethernet PON aims to overcome small link capacity and ineffective link utilization of PONs by optimally combining TDM and WDM solutions while guaranteeing high port-share and flexibility required for evolutionary network.

articleTitle: Method for measuring high order dispersion in optical fibers
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We report on a four-wave-mixing based method for measuring the ratio between the third and the fourth-order dispersion coefficients with error of less than 3% in dispersion shifted and non-zero dispersion shifted fibers.

articleTitle: Layer 1 Virtual Private Network
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: This paper presents layer 1 virtual private networks (VPNs), which is a new service by utilizing optical transmission and networking technologies. It presents service concepts, network architectures, and protocols based on standardization progress.

articleTitle: Long-Haul Raman-Assisted EDFA Systems with Ultra-Long Spans
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present a methodology to optimize a Raman assisted EDFA transmission system. We analyzed span lengths from 120 km to 210 km and then give in-depth numerical and experimental results for 150 km spans.

articleTitle: Silicon-on-insulator platform for building fiber-to-the-home transceivers
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A silicon-on-insulator platform is proposed for building bi-directional transceivers for fiber-to-the-home applications. The platform includes a monolithically integrated planar reflective grating and a multi-stage interferometer combined with hybridization structures for placement of lasers and photodetectors.

articleTitle: All-Optical Clock Recovery Using the Temporal Talbot Effect
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate novel all-optical clock recovery for short pulse communication systems based on the temporal Talbot effect. By simply propagating a data stream through 80 km of single-mode fiber, we generate a periodic pulse train.

articleTitle: Broadband All-Order Polarization Mode Dispersion Compensation
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate broadband all-order polarization mode dispersion (PMD) compensation by applying broadband states of polarization sensing, frequency-resolved optical gating (FROG), and ultrafast pulse shaping techniques.

articleTitle: Residual Stress Effects on Post-fabrication Resonance Wavelength Trimming of Long-Period Fiber Gratings
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Residual stress effects are examined by heating long-period gratings written in the fibers un-relaxed and relaxed the stress. It becomes evident that the trimming range of resonance wavelengths can be expanded by adjusting heating temperature.

articleTitle: A Self-restorable Colorless Bidirectional WDM-PON based on ASE-injected FP-LDs
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose and demonstrate a cost-effective self-restorable bi-directional WDM-PON based on ASE-injected FP-LDs, which utilizes the periodic and routing characteristics of the arrayed waveguide grating. The network restoration was achieved within 7 ms.

articleTitle: Coordinated Resource Scheduling in High-performance Optical Grids
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: This paper investigates coordinated resource scheduling algorithms for high- performance optical grids. We introduce a simple scheduling algorithm and study its impact on grid performance.

articleTitle: SOI Photonic Wire Based Components with Compact and Efficient Fiber Couplers
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present compact wavelength selective functions based on SOI photonic wires, like AWGs, Mach-Zehnder filters and ring resonators, fabricated with CMOS processes. We couple to single-mode fiber with grating couplers, which also allow polarization-independent behaviour.

articleTitle: Adaptive Pulse Shaping Through BER Feedback
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose a simplified approach to optical signal pre-distortion based on adaptive pulse shaping through unconventional use of a MZ modulator. The scheme allows natural tailoring of transmitted pulses by optimising the received pulse.

articleTitle: Video Overlay in Next Generation Passive Optical Networks
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose and demonstrate a novel PON architecture to increase bandwidth per user and to alleviate degradation of analog video due to Raman crosstalk. Measurements of carrier-to- spur ratio of analog video overlay are presented.

articleTitle: High-Speed Phase-Correlated Signal Generation by Phase-Reconstruction of OTDM Signals through Differential Cross-Phase Modulation in an SOA-MZI
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose a method to generate high-speed coherent phase-modulated signals using DXPM in an SOA-MZI. Results include generation of 80-Gb/s RZ-DPSK, CSRZ, GAP-CSRZ, PAP-CSRZ, and AMI modulation formats. The technique also enables output pulse-width control.

articleTitle: Digital terrestrial broadcasting transport system in SDH network
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We have developed a digital terrestrial broadcasting transport system to realize the broadcast infrastructure based on a SDH network, and confirmed a high accurate frequency transmission of OFDM sample clock in a SDH network.

articleTitle: Impact of Polarization Hole Burning in Lightly Loaded Ultra Long-Haul WDM Systems
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: In lightly loaded ultra-long WDM systems, which use idlers for power management, we show experimentally that a higher inline EDFA output power can significantly reduce the PHB-induced performance fluctuations, with enhanced system margin in result.

articleTitle: A Tunable Dispersion Compensator with Highly Refractive Silicon Etalons
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We used highly refractive silicon etalons to develop a tunable dispersion compensator with plusmn250-ps/nm tunable range and low <2.3-dB loss (2.1-dB improvement). We demonstrated 40-Gbps-NRZ transmissions with 1000-ps/nm tunable range in a double-pass configuration.

articleTitle: All-Fiber PMD Emulator with Reduced Number of Polarization Controllers between Sections
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose an all-fiber PMD emulator based on polarization-maintaining-fiber and fiber-squeezer type polarization controllers. The number of polarization controllers has been significantly reduced to lower the cost without distorting the statistical distributions.

articleTitle: Electrically tunable long period gratings in liquid crystal photonic bandgap fibers
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate an aLl-electrically tunable long period grating in a photonic crystal fiber infiltrated with a nematic liquid crystal. The spectral dips and the resonance wavelengths are tuned electrically and thermally, respectively.

articleTitle: Fabrication of helicoidal long-period fiber gratings by twisting a standard single mode fiber
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We report a new method of fabrication of helicoidal long-period fiber gratings by twisting a single mode fiber with CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> laser beam. The transmission characteristics of helicoidal long-period fiber gratings were experimentally demonstrated.

articleTitle: Ultrawide bandwidth λ-converter with regeneration properties based on cross phase modulation effect in highly non linear dispersion flattened fiber
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate and theoretically verily for what is believed to be the first time that a almost unlimited bandwidth λ-conversion can be achieved. 2R-functionality is also reported. Effect is based on cross-phase modulation between.

articleTitle: Novel TO-BOSA for FTTH using New Optical Path Alignment Technology
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose a new assembly technique that provides a cost-effective way to integrate Tx and Rx in one TO-package. The TO-BOSA developed using this technique performed sufficiently well for FTTH service applications.

articleTitle: All-Optical Combinatorial Network based on SOAs for Packet Contention Resolution in a 2 × 2 Photonic Node
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A complex integrable all-optical combinatorial network based on semiconductor optical amplifiers is demonstrated. As an application, contention detection and switching control in 2times2 photonic node is performed in a diverse priority self routing packet network.

articleTitle: Effects of Structural Distortions on Photonic Band-gap Fibers
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A scanning electron micrograph of a photonic band-gap fiber profile is analyzed using a finite element method. It is shown that structural distortions have significant impacts on fiber properties such as bandwidth and tunneling loss.

articleTitle: System Performance of DPSK Signals Transmitted Through Broadband SBS-based Slow Light Element and Reduction of Slow-Light-Induced Data-Pattern Dependence
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate 42 ps delay on 10.7-Gb/s DPSK signals via SBS-based slow light. Slow-light-induced DPSK-data-partern dependence is analyzed and its reduction results in 3-dB Q factor improvement. NRZ-DPSK and RZ-DPSK system performances are compared.

articleTitle: CPFSK/MSK Modulation with a Monolithic Integrated LiNbO3 Modulator
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose a high-speed CPFSK/MSK modulation technique using a single-stage monolithic-integrated dual-arm driven FSK modulator. By measuring phase trajectory, we directly confirmed that the externally modulated lightwave was truly continuous in phase to form CPFSK/MSK.

articleTitle: Inline Cryogenic Temperature Sensor Based on the Excitation of Localized Plasmonic Oscillations in Metallic Nanoparticles Embedded into Photonic Crystal Fibers
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We describe the operation of an inline temperature sensor based on the inclusion of metallic nanoparticles into a photonic crystal fiber. A robust sensing platform for spectroscopy and optical switching applications can be designed.

articleTitle: A Novel Approach to Reduce Waveguide Intersection Loss of HIC Materials
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We have demonstrated a novel universal-waveguide crossing design to reduce intersection-loss in HIC PLCs. This design provides superior performance and feature-size-efficiency than existing designs. We have successfully applied the scheme to Δ=1.5%, Δ=17%, and SOI materials and verified experimentally on Δ=1.5% material.

articleTitle: Tunable Ultrafast and Ultraslow Light in Erbium Doped Waveguide at Room Temperature
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: This investigation experimentally demonstrates tunable ultrafast and ultraslow light in an erbium doped waveguide for the first time. Group velocity of about -67.5 m/s (fast light) and 12.4 m/s (slow light) are reported.

articleTitle: Evanescently-Coupled Dual-Depletion-Region Traveling-Wave Electroabsorption Modulator with High-Speed and Low-Driving-Voltage Performance
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: By incorporating dual-depletion-region electroabsorption modulator with an evanescently-coupled waveguide, the demonstrated device can achieve low electrical return-loss (<-22dB), wide electrical 3-dB transmission-loss bandwidth (~70 GHz), wide electrical-to-optical bandwidth (>45 GHz), and low-driving-voltage (V<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">20dB</sub>, 1.65 V) with small polarization-dependency.

articleTitle: Microfiber photonics
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: This paper reviews recent progress in understanding the transmission properties of microfiber and nanofiber waveguides and tapers. Prospects for optical microfiber devices are also discussed.

articleTitle: Status of Optical Modules and Sub-Systems Standards
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The current status of standardisation of the optical specifications applied to transmitters and receivers is reviewed with particular emphasis on the standards emerging from the ITU-T targeted at Metro DWDM links.

articleTitle: Progress in active fibers
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Progress in active fibers for high power fiber sources is discussed. The waveguiding geometry naturally lends itself to high-power diffraction-limited operation. Further refinements allow for the control of nonlinearities and wavelength. Fabrication advances mitigate photodarkening.

articleTitle: Integrated Optical Filter with Fast Electrically Reconfigurable Transfer Function
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate here an integrated optical filter based on lithium niobate, with fast electrically reconfigurable transfer function. The technique is based on phase-shift keying of the reflection Bragg grating in a waveguide. The transfer function can be favourably reconfigured by applying different combinations of electrical voltage to the electrode pairs on both sides of the waveguide. The time of reconfiguration is less than 1 μs.

articleTitle: Experimental Demonstration of a Complete SPINet Optical Packet Switched Interconnection Network
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A 4times4 fully implemented photonic interconnection network is experimentally demonstrated. The network routes 60 Gb/s wavelength-striped packets (6times10 Gb/s) error-free in the optical domain, resolves contentions, and detects dropped packets via a unique acknowledgement protocol.

articleTitle: All-optical multiple-label-processing based optical packet switch prototype and novel 10 gb ethernet / 80 (8λ × 10) gbps-wide colored optical packet converter with 8- channel array burst-mode packet transceiver
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate IP-packet/10-Gbit-Ethernet transporting by novel 80-Gbit/s/port optical packet switch prototype with IP/OP converters, packet-transceiver of instantaneous- locking (≪1 ns), and multiple-label-processor of ultra-fast processing (/spl Gt;100 ps) to achieve 7.2- Gbps IP-packet throughput with low packet-loss-rate (<10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-6</sup>).

articleTitle: Recent Advances in AlInsAs Avalanche Photodiodes
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present practical planar AlInAs APDs, which have large gain-bandwidth products, low noise, and high reliability. The APD receivers had a sensitivity of-28.6 dBm at 10 Gb/s and -37.0 dBm at 2.5 Gb/s.

articleTitle: High-energy ultrashort pulse generation from a fundamentally mode-locked fiber laser at 1.7 MHz
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose and demonstrate a self-starting, fundamentally mode-locked fiber laser stabilized by a single-wall carbon nanotube saturable absorber, capable of generating 200-fs, 1-nJ pulses at a low repetition rate of 1.7 MHz.

articleTitle: Filter Impact in Spectrally-Broadened Rayleigh Noise Reduction Schemes for DWDM-PONs
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present the results of a model for phase modulated spectrally-broadened Rayleigh backscattering noise reduction scheme employed in centralized light source DWDM-PONs. Good agreement with experiments is demonstrated, and different optical filtering strategies are investigated.

articleTitle: Demonstration of a 16-channel code-reconfigurable OCDMA/DWDM system
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We report a reconfigurable 16-channel OCDMA/DWDM system (40CDMAx4DWDMx625Mbit/s) based on novel 31-chip, 40 Gchip/s quaternary phase coding gratings operating at a channel spacing of just 50GHz. Error free performance is achieved for all channels.

articleTitle: Impairment-aware Waveband Switching in Optical Networks
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We consider optical impairment and investigate wavelength grooming strategies in multi-granular WDM networks. The strategy that allows lightpaths to share waveband paths holds better call blocking and port usage performance than that without sharing.

articleTitle: Spectrally Efficient 10 × 1 Gb/s QPSK Multi-User Optical Network Architecture
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We report theoretical and experimental validation of a 10 times 1 Gb/s multi-user optical network using SCM-QPSK modulation for good spectral efficiency. Low-penalty-transmission is demonstrated for a proof-of-principle 2 channel system over 25 km SMF.

articleTitle: NEDO Project on Photonic Network Technologies ---Development of an OBS Node Prototype and Key Devices
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present a summary of the optical burst switching (OBS) node prototype and major components achieved in NEDO-funded Photonic Network Project. Advanced devices such as matrix switch, wavelength converter and tunable lasers are reported.

articleTitle: A novel high frequency magnetostrictive composite-fiber Bragg grating sensor
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A high frequency magnetostrictive composite-fiber Bragg grating (MC-FBG) sensor using novel epoxy-bonded terfenol-D particulate magnetostrictive composite is proposed and experimentally demonstrated. The MC-FBG sensor exhibits a high frequency response up to at least 60 kHz.

articleTitle: Optical Equalization of 42.7-Gbaud Band-Limited NRZ-DQPSK Signals for High-Spectral-Efficiency Transmission
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate the use of an optical equalizer to allow a 42.7-Gbaud (85.4-Gb/s) NRZ-DQPSK signal to tolerate the narrow optical filtering required in high-spectral-efficiency systems. The equalizer passbands are repetitive, enabling equalization of multiple channels.

articleTitle: 42dB Loss Budget Hybrid DWDM-CDM-PON without Optical Amplifier
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: First time, an unprecedented 42dB loss budget was realized by using hybrid DWDM-CDM (Code Division Multiplexing)-PON without optical amplifier. We experimentally demonstrated 100km 16λ-DWDM-CDM-PON bidirectional transmission with 62.5Mbps × 32 users/λ symmetry guaranteed bandwidth. Long reach PON is expected to reduce CapEx and OpEx cost.

articleTitle: Transmitter Comparison and Unequal Bit Error Probabilities in Coherent QPSK Systems
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We compare different QPSK transmitters and find that some simple configurations can give rise to a significant difference in BER between the two transmitted bits. The optimum receiver filter bandwidth is affected by this phenomenon.

articleTitle: Upgrades of Non-Slope Matched Submarine Transmission Systems Using Differential Phase Shift Keying
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: This paper studies the performance of RZ-DPSK at 10, 20 and 40 Gb/s for application on NZDSF based submarine systems. It compares the upgraded performance with respect to the original RZ-ASK modulation and bit rate.

articleTitle: Chalcogenide glass waveguides and grating devices for all-optical signal conditioning
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Review of recent achievements in chalcogenide glass waveguide and fiber based all- optical signal processing devices utilizing both short and long period gratings as well as the inherent ultra-fast, ultra-strong, third-order nonlinearities.

articleTitle: High resolution extraction of fiber propagation parameters for accurate modeling of slow light systems based on narrow band optical parametric amplification
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The spatial distributions of fiber propagation parameters are estimated with a high spatial resolution using measured ASE spectra of narrow parametric gain. This allows accurate modeling of slow light propagation of high bit rate data.

articleTitle: High-Performance Passive Microwave-Photonic Link for Antenna Remoting Using Truncated Single-Sideband Optical Phase Detection
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A passive analog link is presented for antenna remoting using phase modulation and a fiber-Bragg-grating phase detector with high frequency selectivity. Carrier suppression and cancellation of 3<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">rd</sup>-order distortion provide high dynamic range (114.4 dB·Hz<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2/3</sup>).

articleTitle: Falling Boundaries from Metro to ULH Optical Transport Equipment
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: With increased price pressure and expanding requirements, metro, regional, and LH/ULH transport equipment are rapidly collapsing toward universal platforms. Enabling technologies and impact of this convergence on optical network architecture and design will be reviewed.

articleTitle: Estimation of absorption loss in siloxane-based materials implemented as passive optical interconnects
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: An empirical equation between integral band strength and intrinsic absorption loss of siloxane-based materials has been derived and loss limits were deduced for their potential implementation in datacom devices with consideration of different transmission distances.

articleTitle: Phase-modulated hybrid 40Gb/s and 10Gb/s DPSK DWDM long-haul optical transmission
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We report the transmission of 40 Gb/s channels over DWDM optically amplified communications systems employing RZ, NRZ, CS-RZ amplitude and differential phase shift keying modulation over 320 km standard SMF and 328 km dispersion compensating modules. Impacts of optical filtering of 10 Gb/s DWDM transmission system on these 40 G modulation formats are reported. The mutual impacts of 10G and 40G co-transmission are proven to be at a minimum level.

articleTitle: Multi-granularity OXC Architecture
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The recent development of optical switching system has triggered research into the next step toward the multi-granularity optical cross-connect (MG-OXC). This paper highlights our recent activities on MG-OXC providing optical burst to waveband switching.

articleTitle: Performance Investigation of Tunable Optical Delay for ASK and DPSK Signals Using Four-Wave Mixing Wavelength Conversion in a Bismuth Oxide Highly Nonlinear Fiber
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A compact fiber-optic approach is demonstrated for an optically controlled variable delay for 10-Gb/s ASK and DPSK signals using four-wave mixing and group velocity dispersion. The measured power penalty is less than 4 dB.

articleTitle: Receiver-side adaptive opto-electronic chromatic dispersion compensation
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate, via comprehensive simulation, a receiver-side adaptive chromatic dispersion compensation technique which reconstructs the received optical signal as an electrical baseband signal and subsequently applies linear electrical filtering to remove chromatic dispersion.

articleTitle: GMPLS RSVP-TE Signaling Recovery with Graceful Restart in Optical User Network Interface
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: OIF UNI signaling re-uses the GMPLS RSVP-TE between clients connected to the transport network. This paper proposes an approach to make use of standard messages to recover the signaling state on the source client router.

articleTitle: Multi-Stage SOA Switch Fabrics: 4×40Gb/s Packet Switching and Fault Tolerance
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Performance of packet switching at 4x40Gb/s through a multi-stage SOA is evaluated. Fault identification and rerouting in the multi-stage switch is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Optical Bandpass Filter with Tunable Chromatic Dispersion and Optical Bandwidth Using a Variable MEMS Reflector
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We report on a grating-based tunable optical filter employing a MEMS reflector with variable curvature and aperture size. The chromatic dispersion, bandwidth, and center wavelength of the optical passband can be controlled continuously and independently.

articleTitle: A Protocol for Efficient Tunable Laser Utilization to Support Incremental Upgrade in a WDM-PON
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present a novel protocol to achieve better utilization of tunable lasers across different user groups in a WDM-PON. We demonstrate the protocol's advantage to support incremental upgrade of bandwidth with increasing user bandwidth request.

articleTitle: High-speed and high-power performance of a dual-step evanescently-coupled uni-traveling-carrier photodiode at a 1.55 μm wavelength
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a dual-step evanescently-coupled uni-traveling-carrier photodiode to minimize the dependence of responsivity on cleaved-length. High responsivity (0.9A/W), wide electrical bandwidth (˜60GHz), and high saturation current-bandwidth product (≫780mA-GHz) have been achieved simultaneously under 50Ω load.

articleTitle: Novel Dopants for Silica-Based Fiber Amplifiers
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We review on some studies of the potential of new dopants in silica fibers for ultrabroadband amplification coverage in the 800-1700 nm range, including transition metal and rare-earth ions, and sensitized nano-particles.

articleTitle: Emerging Network Need for Alien Wavelength Management
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Optical-transmission-distance reaches coast-to-coast without regeneration; costs have been reduced due to elimination of regenerations. Mixed-traffic-pattern leads to challenging task of managing the dynamic-wavelength which traverses multiple-network-domains. Effective optical interoperability starts with proper management of alien wavelength.

articleTitle: Integration of Dual-Code Optical CDMA Encoder and Decoder by Holographic Bragg Reflectors
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A matching integrated OCDMA encoder-decoder pair based on holographic Bragg reflector technology was fabricated. Simultaneous en/decoding operation of two wavelength-hopping time-spreading codes was successfully performed at OC-24. A double-pass scheme was employed for longer code-length.

articleTitle: Statistical study of a novel launch scheme for high-performance electronic-equalized multimode-fiber links
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A novel launch scheme is proposed for multimode-fiber (MMF) links. Enhanced performance in 10 Gb/s MMF links using electronic equalization is demonstrated by statistical analysis of installed-base fiber and an experimental investigation.

articleTitle: A Novel Full-Duplex Wavelength-Reuse Optical-Wireless Architecture with Directly Modulated SOA as Upstream Colorless Amplified Modulator
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate novel full-duplex optical-wireless architecture using optical phase modulator and interleaver for downstream optical mm-wave generation and wavelength reuse for upstream. A directly modulated SOA is employed to eliminate amplifiers and external modulators at the base station.

articleTitle: Amplifier Performance of Double-Clad Er/Yb-Doped Fiber with Cross-Section Tailored for Direct Splicing to the Pump and Signal Fibers
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present characterization of an optical fiber amplifier based on a newly developed double-clad erbium- and ytterbium-doped fiber and pumping method, where the pump and signal fibers are directly spliced to the gain fiber.

articleTitle: Design and Performance of High-Rate Irregular LDPC Codes for Turbo Equalization of PMD Channels
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Applying LDPC codes to turbo equalization of PMD channels requires them to be adopted to the equalizer. A design using fitted EXIT functions offers improved OSNR tolerance of ca. 5 dB compared to MLSE equalization.

articleTitle: DPSK Signal Regeneration Using a Nonlinear Amplifying Loop Mirror
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Power characteristics and phase functions of a NALM are investigated in simulations and experimentally, showing a phase-preserving nonlinear characteristics suitable for amplitude regeneration of phase-encoded signals. A negative power penalty of -1.5 dB was obtained.

articleTitle: Over 5-months Long-Term PMD Continuous Measurement in Installed Fiber Cables with an Exposed Fiber Section
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We report continuous PMD measurements (> 5-months) of installed fiber cables with exposed fiber section. Standard deviations of measured mean DGD with large daily fluctuations lie within theoretical uncertainties. Accuracy is related to measurement intervals.

articleTitle: A Novel WDM-PON Architecture with Centralized Lightwaves in the OLT for Providing Triple Play Services
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A novel WDM-PON architecture with centralized lightwave source in the optical line terminal (OLT) for providing triple play services has been proposed and demonstrated. Triple play service provision with 2.5 Gbit/s video signals, 10 Gbit/s downstream signals, and 10 Gbit/s upstream signals per channel has been successfully realized.

articleTitle: Impacts of Multiple Backups and Multi-Link Sharing among Primary and Backups for Dynamic Service Provisioning in Survivable Mesh Networks
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose a reliability analysis for connections with 1 + N protection and primary-backup k-link sharing. We develop a cost-effective dynamic provisioning scheme to carry connections which have stringent SLA requirements with availability guarantee and resource efficiency.

articleTitle: A Study on Residual Distortion Equalization in Combination with Pre-distortion and Post-equalization
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We show numerically that in a 40Gb/s-QPSK system, dispersion incompletely compensated by pre-distortion can be precisely equalized by a post-equalizer. The compensation capability is strongly dependent on the demodulation scheme, i.e. coherent or incoherent.

articleTitle: Optical Feedback-Tolerant 1.3 μm Gain-Coupled DFB lasers for isolator-free micro-BOSA modules
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Gain-coupled (GC)-DFB-LD tolerant to optical feedback was developed for low-cost, isolator-free optical subassembly module. GC-DFB-LD into isolator-free micro-BOSA module has power penalty less than 0.3 dB after 25 km transmissions at 1.25 Gb/s with -15 dB optical feedback.

articleTitle: Brillouin Scattering in Radio over Fiber transmission
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Radio-over-fiber signal transmission in stimulated-Brillouin-scattering (SBS)-limited systems is investigated. We found that SBS threshold is identical for 3G-RoF links and CW transmission and demonstrate that laser current modulation or increased SBS threshold fiber improves performance.

articleTitle: Offset Sideband Modulation at 2.5 GSym/s
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The generation of an optical carrier and 2.5-GSym/s offset modulated sideband is demonstrated using arbitrary optical waveform generation and a single laser and modulator. In this demonstration, the sideband is modulated using QPSK and 16-QAM.

articleTitle: 140 Carrier, 20GHz SCM Signal Transmission across 200km SMF by Two-step Sideband Suppression Scheme in Optical SSB Modulation
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose a two-step sideband suppression scheme to realize enhanced optical SSB generation. 140 carrier, super wideband (8 GHz to 20 GHz) SCM transmission across 200 km of SMF is demonstrated. The scheme achieves high sideband suppression ratios.

articleTitle: Long-Haul 40 Gb/s RZ-DPSK Transmission over 4,450 km with 150-km Repeater Spacing using Raman Assisted EDFAs
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: 40Gb/s RZ-DPSK signals were successfully transmitted over 4450km with 150km repeater spacing (33dB span loss) using Raman assisted EDFAs. The performance was compared with EDFA only amplification and 110km repeater spacing. Long-term Q-factor fluctuations were also quantified for Raman-assisted amplification.

articleTitle: Digitally Tunable Optical Frequency Converter based on Optical SSB Modulators and Mach-Zehnder Interferometers
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A digitally tunable optical frequency converter using optical SSB modulators and Mach-Zehnder interferometers has been proposed. The optical frequency up-conversion and down-conversion of this converter is controlled by varying the bias voltage of the modulator.

articleTitle: Optically-Addressable Packet Timeslot Interchanger Using a Quadruple Switch Array
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose and demonstrate a wavelength converter-based time-slot-interchanger architecture consisting of cascaded programmable delay stages. It uses an integrated quadruple switch array of HMZI switches and operated error-free with 10 Gb/s NRZ packets.

articleTitle: Impact of Phase Ripple In Fiber Bragg Grating Based Tunable Dispersion Compensator On 10 Gb/s NRZ Transmission
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The influence of phase response ripple on the performance of a tunable dispersion compensator using fiber Bragg grating-based distributed Gires-Tournois etalons is investigated experimentally for 10 Gb/s NRZ transmission. The results reveal the implications of the phase ripple profile on the dispersion compensating performance.

articleTitle: Tunable complex-coefficient incoherent Microwave Photonic Filters based on optical single-sideband modulation and narrow-band optical filtering
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We introduce a novel scheme to implement tunable incoherent microwave-photonic filters with complex coefficients using optically-induced RF phase shift. A two-tap filter is experimentally demonstrated to highlight its enhanced tuning performance.

articleTitle: Novel Fault Monitoring and Localization Scheme in WDM-PONs with Upstream VCSEL Transmitters
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A simple and highly-sensitive (-67 dBm) fault monitoring and localization scheme is achieved without modifications to the ONU, by utilizing a low bandwidth (~2 kHz) and low power (~-7 dBm) fault monitor and the high reflectivity mirror of VCSEL transmitters.

articleTitle: A 2.5 Gb/s Edge-Detecting Burst-Mode Receiver for GPON Access Networks
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We describe a 2.5 Gb/s burst-mode receiver featuring edge-detecting data recovery. A high-performance SiGe comparator and standard optical front-end combination removed all burst-format issues. Error-free performance was achieved in a 32 km radius GPON test-bed.

articleTitle: Suppressed Carrier Optical Transmitter with Intracavity Modulation for Coherent Analog Optical Links
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A suppressed carrier optical heterodyne link was demonstrated experimentally with high dynamic range. An efficient laser ring oscillator for heterodyne links is proposed where an intracavity modulator outputs a suppressed carrier signal while recirculating the carrier around the ring.

articleTitle: Field Trial of Photonic Switches for Efficient Fiber Network Operation and Maintenance
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Results of Verizon field trial using MEMS and beam-steering photonic switching technologies for automating network operation and maintenance functions show that operational expenses and downtime can be significantly reduced.

articleTitle: Maximum Likelihood Sequence Estimation for Chromatic Dispersion and Polarization Mode Dispersion Compensation in 3-Chip DPSK Modulation Format
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We show that maximum-likelihood-sequence estimation (MLSE) of 10-Gbit/s 3-chip DPSK exhibits 1.6 dB penalty bound for 100-ps DGD and the CD tolerance 1.5 times of that of MLSE-equalized 10-Gbit/s 2-chip DPSK.

articleTitle: Error-Free 320 Gb/s Simultaneous Add-Drop Multiplexing
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We report on the first demonstration of error-free time-division add-drop multiplexing at 320 Gb/s. The add- and drop-operations are performed simultaneously in a non-linear optical loop mirror with only 100 m of highly non-linear fibre.

articleTitle: Delay Sensitive Smoothed Round Robin (DS2R2) Scheduler for Light-trail and SLiT Networks
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
