abstract: We propose Delay Sensitive Smoothed Round Robin scheduling algorithm for provisioning services over light- trail and SLiT networks. Compliance to latencies of services such as PWE3, VoD, Voice and data and good efficiency are observed.

articleTitle: Tunable laser source for fast wavelength switching using a short-cavity DBR laser packaged with wavelength locker
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Simple switching scheme of frequency with precise feedback control of robust wavelength locker has been presented for a short-cavity DBR laser array. Switching time was less than 13 μsec within +/- 2.5GHz from ITU grid.

articleTitle: On the Upgrade of an Optical Code Division PON with a Code-Sense Ethernet MAC Protocol
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose, for the first time, optical code-sense multiple access / collision detection to upgrade an optical code division passive optical network with minor modifications to transparently deploy Ethernet (or packet) based services.

articleTitle: Study of a Multi-wavelength Regenerative subsystem based on Quantum Dot Semiconductor Optical Amplifiers at 40Gbps
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: For the first time to our knowledge we perform a study related with multi-wavelength 2R regeneration based on cross-gain modulation (XGM) operation at 40 Gbps using quantum-dot semiconductor optical amplifiers (QD-SOAs).

articleTitle: Advance reservation-based network resource manager with adaptive path discovery scheme for SOA-based networking
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Latency-aware adaptive path discovery scheme with optimized resource scheduling mechanism were proposed for the advance reservation-capable SOA-based networking architecture. Using proposed techniques, advance reservation and service modification operations invoked from Web-services interface were experimentally demonstrated.

articleTitle: Network Performability Evaluation for different Routing Schemes
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We compare the performance of three different schemes for selecting restoration paths in a typical inter-city backbone network under 500,000 single and multiple failure scenarios.

articleTitle: Hybrid Optical-Wireless Networks
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: As the convergence in digital industry takes shape, the digital networks, both wireline and wireless, are also converging to offer seamless services and enhanced experience to the user. In this paper we explore why, what, and how of the optical-wireless network convergence. We also present some of the dominant network architectures that are emerging, and identify the key barriers to achieving true network convergence. We then discuss the role of the Internet protocol (IP) as the common thread that enables network convergence.

articleTitle: A Performance Optimization Method for SOA-MZI Devices
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present a novel characterization method for semiconductor optical amplifier Mach-Zehnder interferometer (SOA-MZI) switches which combines a pump-probe measurement with an interferometer bias scan. This enables optimal bias identification and better understanding of switching dynamics.

articleTitle: A High-performance PON System for Both Access and Local Networking Using Wavelength-Switchable Transceivers
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose a new PON architecture where both access and local networking services are enabled using wavelength-switchable transceivers. Simulation shows that available bandwidth is nearly doubled with fast wavelength switching and delay is drastically improved.

articleTitle: WDM-PON Architecture with C-band OLT, L-band ONU, and U-band Monitoring Based on FP-LDs wavelength-locked by a Single, Depolarized, CW Supercontinuum
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a novel bidirectional WDM-PON architecture based on a single, depolarized, 130 ran, CW supercontinuum source. The architecture incorporating low- cost, wavelength-locked FP-LDs features a unique wavelength band allocation scheme of the C- band for an OLT, the L-band for ONUs, and the U-band for channel monitoring.

articleTitle: A Reconfigurable All-Optical AND/OR Logic Gate using Multilevel Modulation and Self-Phase Modulation
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrated a reconfigurable and polarization-independent all-optical logic gate based on multilevel modulation and self-phase modulation. Reconfigurable logic AND and OR operations were realized by simply adjusting the center frequency of an optical band-pass filter.

articleTitle: A Compact Polarization-Independent Wavelength Duplexer Using a Polarization-Diversity SOI Photonic Wire Circuit
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present a wavelength duplexer in silicon-on-insulator photonic wires. We made a polarization-diversity circuit using fiber grating couplers with polarization splitter and a bidirectional AWG, resulting in a polarization dependent loss of only 0.66dB.

articleTitle: CMOS Compatible Guided-Wave Tunable Optical Equalizer
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A compact 4<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup>-order pole-zero optical filter fabricated entirely in a silicon complementary metal-oxide semiconductor foundry is configured as a tunable optical equalizer. Equalization of a bandwidth-limited 10-Gb/s signal is demonstrated with a single voltage control.

articleTitle: Enabling ASON Routing via Novel Signal Quality Metrics
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose a new algorithm for path selection in automatically switched optical networks (ASONs), based on eye closure penalty, Q-factor and a modified OSPF protocol. We demonstrate the technique for a nine node network.

articleTitle: Bidirectional Amplifier for Standard PON Architecture in Burst Mode Configuration with Class B+ Attenuation Range
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A single bidirectional semiconductor optical amplifier is introduced in a Passive Optical Network system. An extended optical budget of 14 dB has been measured for a bidirectional transmission with class B+ specification.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Protection Schemes Compatible with Smooth Migration from TDM-PON to Hybrid WDM/TDM-PON
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose a novel protection scheme compatible with smooth migration from TDM-PON to WDM/TDM-PON. We show that our scheme is very cost-effective while keeping connection availability, recovery time and power budget at the acceptable level.

articleTitle: Cascaded Modulation Scheme for Optical Multi-Channel Signal Transmission Systems
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We report a cascaded modulation scheme that uses multiple concatenated external modulators to modulate continuous wave light. It offers better modulation performance than the conventional single modulation scheme for optical multi-channel signal transmission.

articleTitle: Multi-area MPLS/GMPLS Interoperability Trial Over 14-Vendor Packet/TDM/ROADM/OXC Network
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A multi-area MPLS/GMPLS interoperability trial was successfully conducted using various types of network elements from 14 vendors for the first time. The results show that the interior gateway routing protocol based multi-area routing architecture is a promising solution to achieve nationwide deployment of GMPLS networks within a carrier domain.

articleTitle: Enhanced Tolerance to Demultiplexing Misalignment in an OTDM System with Hybrid RZ-ASK/DPSK Formats
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose a novel OTDM scheme with hybrid RZ-ASK/RZ-DPSK formats and investigate its demultiplexing performance. Experiment showed the tolerances to demultiplexing timing misalignment were improved by 180% and 70%, for RZ-ASK and RZ-DPSK channels, respectively.

articleTitle: Coherent Receivers for Phase-Shift Keyed Transmission
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We review coherent receiver implementations and their performance for phase-shift keyed transmission. Experimental results of a heterodyne receiver for 10 Gb/s DPSK are presented as well.

articleTitle: Two Pump Parametric Amplifier with 40dB of Equalized Continuous Gain over 50nm
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A two-pump fiber parametric amplifier was constructed and measured to have record performance. A continuous-wave 40dB gain was equalized over 50nm, covering the extended L-band spectral domain. The experimental measurements were matched with the theoretical calculations.

articleTitle: Approaches to Support Various Types of Traffic in WDM Networks
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We investigate three traffic grooming and static and dynamic bandwidth provisioning approaches to support various types of traffic in WDM networks, and show in general, a polymorphous OCS/OBS approach is most efficient.

articleTitle: Optical Interface for IMD Reduction in Fiber-Radio Systems with Simultaneous Baseband Transmission for Heterogeneous Access Networks
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose an optical interface incorporating an arrayed waveguide grating (AWG) that simultaneously reduces intermodulation distortion (IMD) and multiplexes DWDM fiber-radio channels while supporting multiple baseband transmission in a heterogeneous access environment.

articleTitle: All-Optical Carrier Phase and Polarization Recovery Using a Phase-Sensitive Oscillator
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: An all-optical carrier phase and polarization recovery scheme from PSK signals is proposed and demonstrated for the first time. The scheme uses a phase-sensitive optical oscillator with a phase sensitive amplifier as the gain block.

articleTitle: Comparison of Mode Properties of 7 and 19 Cells Core Hollow-Core Photonic Crystal Fibers
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We compare the mode properties of fibers with 7 and 19 cells core, the operational bandwidth and loss of the fibers is compared and trade offs between low loss and wide operational bandwidth are presented.

articleTitle: 10 Gb/s AC-Coupled Digital Burst-Mode Optical Receiver
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A 10 Gb/s NRZ digital burst-mode optical receiver without any line-coding has been realized using an AC-coupled photodiode and asynchronous 20 GS/s ADC. Symbol timing, amplitude and baseline wander corrections are implemented with digital signal processing.

articleTitle: 10.7 Gbit/s Transmission over 220 m Polymer Optical Fiber using Maximum Likelihood Sequence Estimation
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference

authors.preferredName: H. P. A. van den Boom

abstract: 10.7 Gbit/s NRZ-signals are transmitted for the first time over 220 m of multimode 120 μm core-diameter perfluorinated graded-index polymer optical fiber using an MLSE equalizer.

articleTitle: Widely Tunable Wavelength Conversion by Four-Wave Mixing in 1-m Dispersion-Shifted Bismuth-Oxide Photonic Crystal Fiber
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate four-wave mixing based wavelength conversion using a 1-meter-long dispersion-shifted bismuth-oxide photonic crystal fiber. A 3-dB conversion range of 35 nm is obtained with around 1-dB power penalty for 10 Gb/s NRZ signal.

articleTitle: A Novel Gb/s Transceiver with OTDR Built-in-test (BIT) for Health Monitoring of Local Area Networks
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We have successfully demonstrated the first prototype Gb/s transceiver with integrated built-in 10-cm resolution OTDR capability. The transceiver performs excellently over 2 Gb/s; it is very beneficial for cable plant fault detection and isolation applications.

articleTitle: Solid Photonic Band-Gap Fiber with 400 nm Bandwidth and Loss below 4 dB/km at 1520 nm
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a wide-band and low-loss (< 4 dB/km at 1520 nm) solid photonic band-gap fiber (PBGF). The fiber is practically single-mode in a long length regime and has a large anomalous dispersion over a wide wavelength range.

articleTitle: Dynamic Compensation of Raman Tilt in a Fiber Link by EDFA during Transient Events
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The tilt in channel power distribution due to Raman induced channel-to-channel interaction can be accurately estimated by relatively simple means. Simulations show that the tilt can be dynamically compensated by adjusting an EDFA tilt.

articleTitle: An electrically pumped hybrid silicon evanescent amplifier
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A hybrid silicon evanescent amplifier utilizing a wafer bonded structure of a silicon waveguide and AlGalnAs quantum wells is demonstrated. Maximum chip gain obtained is 13 dB with a 3 dB output saturation power of 11 dBm.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of GMPLS-based Optical Slot Switching Access-distribution Network Using PLZT Ultra-high Speed Optical Switch
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We design and implement a GMPLS-based optical slot switching access-distribution network using PLZT switches. Switching speed is better than 10 nsec and the network has a large scalability, 1000 users, compared to PON.

articleTitle: Grating Stabilized High Power 980nm Pump Modules
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We describe the next generation high power, single-mode 980 nm laser diode for EDFA pumping. The FBG-stabilized pump modules produce 0.7 W kink-free power with superior reliability and performance.

articleTitle: Techno-Economic Evaluation of Optical Access and Metropolitan Area Networks: The Influence of the Status of Maturity of the Photonics Component Industry
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A techno-economic evaluation of the business aspects of optical networks in the access/metro optical networks is given and its relation to the evolution of the photonic component industry is highlighted.

articleTitle: Supercontinuum spectrum broadening by one-bobbin compact modules comprised of re-coated comb-like profiled fiber and HNLF
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrated SC spectrum broadening from the original value of 25nm to 100nm without changing output power and module size by the efficient pulse compression and novel package of a 6-step CPF and a 500m HNLF.

articleTitle: All-optical Re-phasing, Re-shaping, and Re-amplification of RZ-DPSK data
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate novel technique for RZ-DPSK regeneration based on converting phase-noise into amplitude-noise and eliminating it using SOA. The system was tested using degraded 2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">23</sup>-1 PRBS. BER shows removal of error-floor with 4 dB power-penalty improvement.

articleTitle: Recent Progress of EDC Commercialization in Addressing Datacom and Telecom Challenges to Enable High-speed Optical Enterprise, Metro and Long-haul Networks
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present a performance overview of the state-of-the-art FFE/DFE-based EDC implementation on the mitigation of optical impairments. The applications cover modal- dispersion-limited 10 Gb/s enterprise system with over 300 m legacy MMFs, and 10 Gb/s metro and long-haul SMF systems for chromatic-dispersion, and/or PMD compensation.

articleTitle: TCP-aware Load-Balanced Routing in Optical Burst-Switched (OBS) Networks
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: TCP-over-OBS is a promising transport paradigm to support next-generation-Internet. Load-balanced OBS improves loss- performance. We identify the ill-effects of load-balancing on TCP-performance due to false-time-outs and false-triple-duplicates. We propose source-ordering to improve TCP-throughput by three-four times.

articleTitle: 10 Gbit/s 1.55μm 25km transmission at 90°c with new self thermally compensated AlGaInAs directly modulated laser
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Large positive detuning is used for self thermal compensation of threshold and power variation in AlGalnAs DFB. 25 km uncompensated and non-amplified SMF transmissions are demonstrated at a constant bias current from 20°C to 90°C.

articleTitle: 40-Channel Transmitter and Receiver Photonic Integrated Circuits Operating at a per Channel Data Rate 12.5Gbit/s
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate 40 channel transmitter and receiver large scale photonic integrated circuits operating as a pair at 12.5 Gbit/s.

articleTitle: 10-Gbps DWDM transmission using multi-frequency light source with 50-GHz channel spacing
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A multi-frequency light source with 50-GHz channel spacing was constructed based on optical frequency comb generation. The error-free 10-Gbps WDM transmission over 100-km was successfully achieved using the multi-frequency light source.

articleTitle: Bending Properties of Hole-assisted Single Polarization Fibers
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We study effects of bending on single polarization fiber performance. Good qualitative agreement between numerical and experimental results is found, which helps to understand fiber deployment conditions and facilitate new design.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Chirp-Managed Lasers in a Dispersion Managed DWDM Transmission over 24 Spans
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We report the first long-haul DWDM transmission using three chirp-managed lasers spaced 50-GHz apart in SSMF at 10-Gb/s. Transmission penalties less than 0.7 dB over a dispersion-managed 1980-km link was measured with performance comparable to NRZ-OOK.

articleTitle: Millimeter-Wave Signal Generation Using Four-Wave Mixing Effect in SOA
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Optical generation millimeter-wave signals employing FWM effect in SOA is proposed. Sextuple fundamental frequency millimeter-wave of 42GHz with 3dB linewidth 20Hz and phase noise less than -75dBc/Hz at 1.6 kHz offset is obtained.

articleTitle: Compact all-fiber Mach-Zehnder interferometers formed in photonic crystal fiber
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose simple but very effective methods for implementing all-PCF interferometers. The interference properties between the core and cladding modes of a PCF are investigated. The spatial frequency of the interference fringe resulting from the same order of cladding mode was linearly proportional to the PCF length forming the interferometer.

articleTitle: Millimeter-wave Harmonic Frequency Up-Conversion Using Selective Sideband Brillouin Amplification
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Using selective sideband Brillouin amplification induced in standard single-mode fiber, we successfully demonstrate harmonic frequency up-conversion of 10 Mbit/s QPSK data carried by 1.55 GHz intermediate frequency into 30 GHz band with larger than 20 dB RF gain.

articleTitle: Novel Fibers for Ultra-Short and High-Power Pulses
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Light propagation in higher-order modes of few-mode fibers leads to unique dispersive properties that are challenging or impossible to achieve in conventional fibers. We will describe their application to devices utilising high-peak-power and ultra-short pulses.

articleTitle: Self-trapping and self-frequency shift of solitons in photonic crystal fiber
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate experimentally for the first time the self-trapping of solitons in highly nonlinear photonic crystal fiber. The trapping occurs at a particular power and is driven by fission of high-order solitons and their self-frequency shift.

articleTitle: Tolerance to optical feedback of 10 Gbps quantum-dash based lasers emitting at 1.55 μm
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: 10 Gbps operation of quantum-dash based lasers emitting at 1.55 μm is investigated under optical feedback. -24 dB maximum optical return loss tolerance is achieved, in spite of a relatively high linewidth enhancement factor.

articleTitle: Different Aspects and Design Considerations of PLC Based ROADM/WSS
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: ROADM and WSS are key network elements in intelligent network. PLC plays an essential role in providing either integrated or hybrid solutions. We will examine the trade-offs and challenges between monolithically integrated and hybrid systems.

articleTitle: Carrier Ethernet Services Preserving SONET and Migrating to the MPLS Network
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Service providers maintain network investment while offering carrier Ethernet services and migrating to MPLS. VCAT and LCAS mapping, plus leaky bucket and dual leaky bucket policing methods, are described along with various flow encapsulation techniques.

articleTitle: Optimal Design of Intermediate Fibers
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The optimum intermediate fiber design for reducing interconnection loss between guided modes of any two dissimilar fibers is rigorously derived. Total interconnection loss is reduced by ≥50%. Results are also generalized for N intermediate fibers.

articleTitle: Employing Mutually Injection-Locked Fabry-Perot Laser Diodes to Setup a Hybrid WDM Transport System
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A hybrid WDM transport system based on mutually injection-locked Fabry-Perot laser diodes (FP LDs) for CATV, 256-QAM and OC-48 transmission is proposed and demonstrated. Mutually injection-locked FP LDs as broadband light source could be relatively simple and cost-effective compared with other demonstrated light source schemes.

articleTitle: 10 Gb/s 100 km transmission up to 80 C over single mode fiber at 1.55 μm with an integrated electro-absorption modulator laser
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present the first results of transmission up to 80°C over 100 km of standard fiber using an integrated electro-absorption modulator lasers. This enables uncooled small form factor metropolitan transmitters.

articleTitle: High Power Parabolic Pulse Generation in Dispersion Decreasing Tapered Fibre
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: High-power pulse propagation in fibre with tapered decreasing normal dispersion is studied experimentally and numerically. With appropriate fibre design and launch conditions generation of parabolic pulse and step-function waveforms in passive fibre is confirmed.

articleTitle: Efficient Stimulated Brillouin Scattering in Single-Mode Tellurite Glass Fiber
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A Brillouin gain coefficient of 2.16 times10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-10</sup> m/W, an order of magnitude larger than that of silica fiber, was measured in tellurite fiber. The Stokes shift and linewidth were 7.882 GHz and 23.6 MHz, respectively.

articleTitle: Field Installable Connector Optimized for Holey Fiber
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: To realize easy field installation of connectors for holey fiber, we developed a novel mechanical splicing technique that utilizes a curing-type material for refractive-index matching instead of conventional liquid-type materials.

articleTitle: Effective gain clamping of semiconductor optical amplifiers by injecting broad-band self-generated amplified spontaneous emission
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A conventional SOA is effectively gain-clamped by the injection of self-generated broadband amplified spontaneous emission. The gain is clamped up to an input power of-2 dBm with an output power in excess of 11 dBm.

articleTitle: Fiber Technologies for Terawatt Lasers
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Terawatt and petawatt laser systems have substantially different requirements for fiber optic technologies than those of conventional telecommunications systems. Specialty fiber-based solutions have been developed to meet the stringent requirements of these diverse applications.

articleTitle: Single-End Spectral Resolved Measurement of Polarization Mode Dispersion in Optical Fibers
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: An improved single-end backreflection technique is proposed to perform the spectral resolved measurement of polarization mode dispersion (PMD) in optical fibers. This technique is based on the PMD dynamical equation, which is realized by measuring the reflected polarization state evolution in both frequency and time domains. An experimental setup, employing continuous-wave and far-end Fresnel reflection, is constructed. The agreement between the results of single-end and forward measurements is very good.

articleTitle: Demonstration of an All-Optical Data Vortex Switch Node
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We report on the fully all-optical operation of a data vortex switch node based on MZI- SOA gates. All-optical self-routing of WDM 10 Gb/s optical packets has been successfully achieved.

articleTitle: Demonstration of A Time-domain Wavelength Interleaved Network Prototype without Optical Buffers and Fast Switches in the Core Nodes
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a packet-switched network prototype without the needs for optical buffers and fast switches in the core. This network architecture is based on time-domain wavelength interleaving of data packets.

articleTitle: Experimental Validation of Fibre Channel over Multi Protocol Label Switching for the Wide-Area Storage Area Networks
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We validated the feasibility of fibre channel over MPLS technology. The fundamental evaluation as well as the statistical multiplexing of FC frame and Ethernet frame over MPLS network was successfully demonstrated for the first time.

articleTitle: All-Optical Reconfigurable Bipolar Tap Microwave Filter Using Photonic Bandgap Fiber and DGD Module
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: An all-optical bipolar tap microwave filter based on photonic bandgap fiber and DGD module is proposed and experimentally demonstrated. The filter provides tunability and reconfigurability along with immunity to optical coherence interference.

articleTitle: Three-Dimensional Switch Matrix based on Polymer Optical Waveguides
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A three-dimensional 1times4 switching matrix based on polymer optical waveguides is reported. Its features are: compactness, small switching electric power, and wavelength independent. This structure can be readily generalized to a mtimesn matrix.

articleTitle: Regeneration of Return-to-Zero 10 Gb/s Fiber Transmission Impairments using a Monolithically Integrated, Widely-Tunable, Photocurrent Driven Wavelength Converter
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Regeneration of transmission impairments is performed using a monolithically- integrated photocurrent-driven wavelength converter. BER measurements show improved receiver sensitivity of 4,4, and 11-dB for regeneration through the device after 0,25 and 50-km of fiber.

articleTitle: Submarine Fibers with Novel Optical Properties Provided by a Restrict-Mode-Excitation Method
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: By applying a restrict mode excitation method, we successfully reduced dispersion slope of NZ-DSF to -0.04ps/nm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>/km and enlarged Aeff of N-MDF as large as 53 μm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>.

articleTitle: An Optimal Algorithm to Fairly Distribute WDM Signals Using Finite Combinations of Discrete Optical Splitters
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The author describes a network planning algorithm to distribute multi-wavelength WDM optical signals fairly to receivers of different sensitivities in a broadcast-and-select environment with optimal system performance.

articleTitle: Experimental Demonstration of Protection Mechanism in OBT Ring Network
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The optical burst transport network is a novel WDM ring network architecture and protocol. In this paper, we investigate network protection of OBT network. The result shows fast link restoration at the OBT ring network.

articleTitle: All-Fiber Passive Mode-Lockers Using Attachable Vertically Aligned Carbon Nanotube Film
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We dramatically improve the preparation process and operation efficiency of carbon nanotube mode-lockers employing a transferable vertically aligned single-walled carbon nanotube film. All-fiber laser mode-locking is achieved utilizing the film attached to a D-shaped fiber.

articleTitle: Telcordia OSS Support Enhancements for Multi-degree ROADM
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: This paper will discuss the recent and emerging Telcordiareg OSS solutions to support evolving WDM architectures driven by the demand for new high speed access technologies and the maturity of wavelength switching components.

articleTitle: Ge Photodetectors Integrated with Waveguides for Electronic-Photonic Integrated Circuits on CMOS Platform
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Ge p-i-n photodetectors monolithically integrated with silicon oxynitride and silicon nitride waveguides on Si CMOS platform are presented. The devices demonstrated high efficiency (1.08A/W) and high-speed (≫ 14 Gbit/s) performances at low bias.

articleTitle: Novel Si-based CMOS Optoelectronic Switching Device Operating in the Near Infrared
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A novel, high performance optoelectronic switch is introduced. The device is a Si-MOSFET with Ge gate that can be fabricated at the nanoscale with very low capacitance. Current gain of up to 1000times is demonstrated.

articleTitle: The Next Frontier in Testing: 40 Gb/s Transmission
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: 40 Gb/s transmission is now commercially available, and many tier-1 operators may deploy it shortly. New modulation formats, tighter sensitivity specifications, dispersion issues, and Raman amplification - what does this involve in terms of testing?

articleTitle: A novel, easy to use Emulator for deterministic generation of pure first and second order PMD
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A novel emulator model enables deterministic generation of first and second order PMD without higher orders. It was used to determine PMD tolerance of different modulation formats, revealing substantial differences in PCD and DEP tolerance.

articleTitle: Photonic-Crystal-Based Chip-Scale Optical Integration
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Ultrasmall and ultra-high-Q optical cavities have been realized in photonic-crystal slabs, which have a number of exceptional features hardly available in other media. These cavities have been applied to all-optical switches and bistable memories in a Si photonic-crystal chip. They are integratable in a small chip and consume extremely small energies. We discuss their potential for on-chip optical integration and digital photonics application, and also describe novel functionalities arising from dynamic tuning of nanocavities.

articleTitle: Monolithic integration of latchable vertical cavity laser with depleted optical thyristor for optical logic gates
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We show latchable optical switches and optical logic gates using the monolithically integrated vertical cavity lasers with depleted optical thyristor. By simply changing a reference switching voltage, this single device operates as two logic functions.

articleTitle: 22-Channel Detuning Capacity of a Side-Mode Injection Locked FPLD for Directly Modulated 2.5Gbit/s DWDM-PON
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: 22-channel detuning capacity of a 2.5Gbit/s directly modulated FPLD under side-mode injection-locking for DWDM-PON is demonstrated with SMSR >35dB, Q-factor 6.8-9.2, locking range of 24nm, power penalty of-0.7dB, and BER of 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-10</sup> at -17 dBm.

articleTitle: Teaching Silicon New Tricks
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The article consists of a Powerpoint presentation on silicon. The areas discussed include: nonlinear silicon photonics, low-cost Ethernet, SONET components, optical interconnects, Raman approach to silicon amplifiers and lasers, free carrier absorption, pulsed operation, coherent anti-stokes coupling.

articleTitle: Two-tier path based shared mesh restoration
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We analyze the restoration capacity and time of a two-tier shared mesh restoration scheme. We discuss two different optimization strategies for the two-tier restoration scheme and resulting restoration capacity savings and performance improvements.

articleTitle: A mode-hop-free, frequency-tunable 40 GHz mode-locked fiber laser
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We have successfully realized a mode-hop-free, frequency-tunable 40 GHz mode-locked fiber laser by installing an optical etalon in the laser cavity. By tuning the etalon peak frequency, the laser frequency was continuously tuned over 1 GHz.

articleTitle: Terahertz Applications and Techniques
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We briefly review techniques for optoelectronic generation and detection of THz waves and give examples for industrial applications of THz imaging systems. As an outlook we discuss the potential of future wireless THz communication systems.

articleTitle: THz Tunable Slow Light in Semiconductor Optical Amplifiers
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We report tunable fractional delays up to 250% for 1ps pulses propagating through a 1.55μm semiconductor optical amplifier at room temperature. Tuning is accomplished either optically or electrically with low amplitude variation across entire range.

articleTitle: A Mode-locked Bi-doped Fiber Laser
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Mode-locking is obtained for the first time in Bi-doped fiber laser. Stable 50-ps laser pulses with a pulse repetition rate of 13 MHz are generated at a wavelength of 1161.6 nm with 2 mW average power.

articleTitle: Fabrication of Silica-Based Optical Waveguide Containing Densified Sampled Grating by UV Beam Scanning
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present fabrication of silica-based optical waveguide containing densified sampled grating by UV beam scanning. By introducing preprocessed phase shift, 100GHz channel spacing reflection spectra was double densified to be 50GHz without elongating sampling period.

articleTitle: Application of coherent anti-Stokes Raman scattering microscopy using photonic crystal fiber with two zero-dispersion wavelengths
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate spectral multiplex CARS microscopy based on a broadband source and a two zero-dispersion wavelength PCF. The quality of the images is similar to those obtained from technically more complex and expensive sources.

articleTitle: Impact of Noise Transfer in Transparent Networks on Different 43 Gb/s Formats
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We experimentally investigate the sensitivity of different 43 Gb/s formats to non-white noise which occurs in a reconfigurable network, and discuss the system design to reduce its penalty.

articleTitle: Advances in Femtosecond Fiber Lasers
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Passively modelocked, femtosecond fiber lasers are discussed. Recent advances in modelocking schemes and cavity designs are reviewed.

articleTitle: Simultaneous measurement of dispersion parameter and length of an optical fiber by using a direct lasing mode detection technique
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A simultaneous measurement technique of the dispersion parameter and the length of an optical fiber has been demonstrated by using a self-seeding laser oscillation of a Fabry-Perot laser and a direct lasing mode detection technique. The measurement errors were less than 0.14% for the length and 1.7% for the dispersion parameter.

articleTitle: Ultra-Wide-Band Low Loss and PDL 1x32 Splitter Polymer Optical Waveguide Chip and Module
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Comparable optical properties to silica were shown by our 1x32 splitter polymer optical waveguide with dopant-free perfluoropolymer core. Insertion losses and polarization dependent losses at 1.31, 1.55, and even 1.65um were <16.3dB, <0.15dB, respectively.

articleTitle: Transmission Performance Maximization of Adaptively Modulated Optical OFDM Signals in MMF Based Links Using Optimum Analogue-to-Digital Converters
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: It will be shown that 40Gb/s over 220m and 32Gb/s over 300m AMOOFDM signal transmission with loss margins of about 15dB is feasible in installed worst-case MMF IMDD links having 3-dB effective bandwidths of 150MHz.km.

articleTitle: optical Signial Processing based on All-Optical Analog-to-Digital Conversion
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Fiber nonlinearities provide us attractive functions for optical signal processing. In this paper, we focus our attention on all-optical analog-to-digital and digital-to-analog conversion schemes which can be applied for wide variety of signal processing.

articleTitle: Impact of Walk-off on FWM in RZ-OOK Transmission
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A model for FWM including pulse walk-off is developed to include degenerate and nondegenerate FWM. It is seen that the walk-off contribution is filtered out for typical RZ-OOK systems. Excellent agreement obtained with SSF simulations.

articleTitle: 44 Gb/s WDM transmission for transoceanic distance using π2 alternate-phase RZ modulation scheme
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We have explored the feasibility of 44 Gb/s WDM transmission over a transoceanic distance using π2-alternate-phase RZ modulation format. We find that π2-alternate-phase RZ performs more than 3 dB better than regular RZ or carrier-suppressed RZ.

articleTitle: All-Optical Signal Reshaping of a 40 Gb/s RZ Signal by Dual-Stage Pump Modulated Four-Wave-Mixing
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: All-optical signal reshaping is demonstrated with a 40 Gb/s RZ signal by using two cascaded pump modulated four-wave-mixing processes. A 5 dB improvement in the receiver sensitivity is reported for a degraded signal input.

articleTitle: Generation of 160-GHz sub-picosecond in-phase pulse train from optical beat signal
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose a method to generate in-phase optical pulse train from optical beat signal based on four-wave mixing and asymmetric spectral filtering. A 160-GHz repeating, 0.7-ps-FWHM, nearly transform-limited, in-phase sech pulse train is successfully generated.

articleTitle: On the influence of ONU-Gain on Transmission in Centrally Seeded-light WDM-PONs
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Gain influence on transmission in reflective-ONU is analyzed theoretically and experimentally. A general expression for the optical signal-to-crosstalk ratio is given. Experimental results with two types of reflective-ONU are in agreement with the theoretical approach.

articleTitle: Network Link Readiness for 40 Gb/s Transport
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Detailed description and analysis of test results for chromatic and polarization-mode dispersions are presented for evaluating the readiness of a TeliaSonera network link to be upgraded at 40-Gb/s line rate. Conclusions and recommendations are provided.

articleTitle: Single-Shot Fiber Dispersionmetry
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A novel white-light interferometry is presented for fiber dispersion measurement. The acquired spectrally-resolved two-dimensional interferogram enables interference-instability-free, instantaneous determination of group delay and dispersion. Various fibers including a birefringent photonic-bandgap fiber were precisely characterized.

articleTitle: Gain-independent SBS based Slow Light in optical Fibers
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We show a simple method to decouple the delay in SBS-based slow-light systems from the Brillouin gain. With this approach the maximum time delay can be enhanced to more than 100 ns in one fiber segment.

articleTitle: Fourier Pulse-Shaper Based Programmable DGD Emulator
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We developed and tested a deterministic differential group delay (DGD) emulator based on a VIPA Fourier pulse-shaper. The DGD emulator can be programmed to generate essentially arbitrary frequency dependent DGD profiles.

articleTitle: Generation of femtosecond pulses at 1350 nm by Cherenkov radiation in higher-order-mode fiber
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a method of generating femtosecond pulses at 1350 nm by exciting Cherenkov radiation in a higher-order-mode fiber with a 1064 nm source. We measure a 134 fs, 0.66 nJ output pulse.

articleTitle: Service Availability in Optical Network Design
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The paper explores survivability concepts for the migration to carrier class next generation IP services over optical transport networks. Design criteria for highly available optical networks are proposed and tradeoffs of different approaches are analyzed.

articleTitle: 100 Gb/s Transmission using Bit-Interleaved LDPC-Coded Modulation
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: An iterative bandwidth-efficient coded modulation scheme based on bit-interleaving, block-circulant low-density parity-check (LDPC) codes, and Many differential phase-shift keying suitable for high-speed transmission at 100 Gb/s (and above) is proposed.

articleTitle: Optical Phase-Locked Loop for Coherent Transmission over 500 km
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We have realized an optical phase-locked loop for coherent transmission over 500 km using heterodyne detection with a <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">13</sup>C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> frequency-stabilized fiber laser. The phase error variance of the intermediate frequency signal was 7.9x10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup> rad.

articleTitle: Video Transport and Distribution for IPTV Networks
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: An end-to-end architecture is needed to help carriers cost effectively meet emerging video demands. An architecture containing ROADM based transport and flexible access provides the scale for video while affording significant CapEx savings.

articleTitle: Centralized Wavelength Monitoring/Stabilization Technique by Dithering Temperature of LD in Power-Splitter-Based WDM-PON
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: This paper proposes a simple and cost-effective wavelength monitoring/stabilization technique for upstream signals in a power-splitter-based dense WDM-PON. We present the concept and experimentally confirm the feasibility of this technique.

articleTitle: Pedestal free pulse compression in nonuniform fiber Bragg gratings
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present the compression of chirped Bragg solitary pulses near photonic band gap of nonlinear fiber Bragg gratings with exponentially decreasing dispersion. Compression factor of the proposed scheme is two times larger than adiabatic compression.

articleTitle: A performance comparison of differential and coherent detections over Ultra Haul transmission of 10Gb/s BPSK
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Differential detection and coherent detection are compared experimentally after ultra long haul transmission of 10 Gb/s BPSK signals. Coherent detection is measured to be less tolerant to fiber nonlinearities than differential detection one.

articleTitle: Data-Dependent Effects on Jitter Measurement
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Data-dependent Jitter of transmitter for non-framed PRBS and SDH-framed signal were simulated. The results showed that Jitter evaluation for transmitters should be identical to the framed pattern used at the final equipment testing.

articleTitle: Bidirectional DFEs for 10Gb/s Ethernet over Multimode Fiber Links: Complexity Reduction and Reach Extension
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose a bidirectional DFE (BiDFE) to mitigate ISI in multimode fibers. We demonstrate that a BiDFE with 8 feedforward and 3 feedback taps per DFE can achieve a reach of 350-400 m over legacy MMF.

articleTitle: The Advantages of PIC based Digital Optical Networks
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: By changing the cost structure associated with the conversion of the optical signal into the electronic domain, photonic integrated circuits (PICs) have spawned a new network architecture; the digital optical network.

articleTitle: An All-fiber Tunable Polarization-Dependent Loss Element
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We describe the implementation of a wavelength-tunable polarization-dependent-loss element on polarization-maintaining fiber using two independently-controlled acoustic gratings. Continuous attenuation in both fast and slow axes at the same wavelength is demonstrated.

articleTitle: An ultrastable wavelength calibration reference constructed from an athermal Mach-Zehnder interferometer filter
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A wavelength reference was constructed by illuminating an athermal silica-based Mach-Zehnder interferometer filter with a broadband light source. The wavelength-voltage response of a Fabry-Perot tunable filter can be calibrated by using the constructed wavelength reference.

articleTitle: Millimeter-wave Electrooptic Polymer-based Ring Resonator Modulation
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Modulation is demonstrated throughout the W-band and at the 139 GHz and 165 GHz resonances of an electro-optic polymer ring resonator-based modulator. The experimentally validated analysis indicates superior high-frequency performance over a similar V<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">π</sub> Mach-Zehnder modulator.

articleTitle: Characteristics of Printed Circuit Interconnect Induced Jitter on 10Gb/s Optical Transmitters
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We report on the effects of printed circuit interconnects on jitter induced in the optical domain. We show this jitter may be equalized without the need for additional clock-and-data recovery prior to optical conversion.

articleTitle: Differential-Phase-Shift Quantum Key Distribution Using Single-Photon Detectors
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A novel type of quantum key distribution (QKD) protocol called differential-phase-shift QKD is described. It uses a weak coherent pulse train, and features simple configuration and efficient use of the time domain.

articleTitle: Parasitic Modes in Large Mode Area Microstructured Fibers
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present experimental evidence for parasitic modes guided by both bandgap and low density of state effects in large mode area silica microstructured fibers and explore ways of minimizing their presence via the fiber geometry.

articleTitle: Mitigation of Patterning Effects at 40 Gb/s by Skewed Channel Pre-Encoding
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Through modelling of direct error computation, a reduction of pattern- dependent errors in a standard fiber-based transmission link at 40 Gb/s rate is demonstrated by application of a skewed data pre-encoding. The trade-off between the bit-error rate improvement and the data rate loss is examined.

articleTitle: DGD Estimation in Optical Systems of High Capacity
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We show when short cable sections with low PMD used in the deployment of long links, the estimated probability of DGD overcomes certain maximum DGD value based on cabler data systematically overestimates PMD power penalties.

articleTitle: Flexible Capacity Assignment in a Multiwavelength Radio Over Fiber Access Network
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present a novel architecture for radio-over-fiber access networks providing flexible capacity assignement. In a multiwavelength optical fiber network, a foldback AWG incorporating an optical switch enables an experimental demonstration of dynamically allocated multiservice capacity.

articleTitle: A Novel, Multi-Service Add-Drop-Multiplexer Architecture for Access and Backhauling Applications With 4.3Gbit/s Line Rate
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: An ADM architecture with 4.3 Gbit/s interface representing the current cost/ bandwidth optimum for GE services is presented. It offers high scalability, interface protection, and drop-and-continue support and is thus optimised for GE access and backhauling applications.

articleTitle: Switchable All-Optical 188-ps Delay Line in AlGaAs
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: An integrated AlGaAs all-optical 188-ps delay line is characterized over the C- and L- bands. Self-switching by input intensity is achieved using a nonlinear directional coupler and a racetrack delay line.

articleTitle: In-Service Fault Localization in WDM Passive Optical Networks
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose a novel in-service fault localization scheme combined and monitored simultaneously. Fiber fault and automatic protection switching in ONUs are monitored in real-time at central office (CO) without interrupting customer service.

articleTitle: Theoretical and Experimental Study of Statistical Decision Method for Link Capacity Adjustment in Photonic IX
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: This paper proposes a statistical decision method for link capacity adjustment and estimates the decision parameters using a numerical simulation in order to achieve stable operation of the proposed method. The results of the experiments conducted using multiple paths confirm the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Realization of RF phase shift on amplitude modulated data for smart antenna in wireless access networks
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Realization of RF phase shift on amplitude modulated wireless data based on single sideband modulation and nonlinear optical loop mirror is demonstrated for smart antenna in wireless access networks. Linear tunable phase-shift with 0~π range is achieved.

articleTitle: All Optical Tunable Wavelength Conversion at ≫160 Gb/s
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We describe error-free 160 Gb/s tunable all-optical wavelength conversion using cascaded sum- and difference-frequency generation in periodically poled LiNbO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> waveguide. By using spectral-shaping, the BER of less than 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-9</sup> is achieved in 23 nm tuning-range.

articleTitle: Employing VCSELs Injection-Locked and Optoelectronic Feedback Techniques to Setup a Bidirectional Radio-on-DWDM Transport System
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A bidirectional radio-on-DWDM transport system based on VCSELs injection-locked and optoelectronic feedback techniques is proposed and demonstrated. Good performances of BER, EVM, and intermodulation distortion to carrier ratio (IMD/C) were obtained in our proposed bidirectional radio-on-DWDM transport systems.

articleTitle: Asynchronous All-Optical Circuit for Serial-to-Parallel Conversion of Label Bits of DPSK Packets
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present a novel asynchronous all-optical circuit for extraction and serial-to-parallel-conversion of label bits from DPSK packets. The circuit requires only two optical switches regardless the label bits number, is scalable, low-power consumption, and compact.

articleTitle: Use of fingers in the core to reduce leakage loss in air-core photonic bandgap fibers
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We show that the leakage loss with small fingers pointing into the core is three orders of magnitude lower than the loss without small fingers. A PBGF core design with low leakage loss is suggested.

articleTitle: Comparison of Methods for Monitoring PMD-Induced Penalty
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present and verify theoretical models relating PMD-induced penalty with four different monitoring techniques, and show they interrelate through system specific constants. We then assess the robustness of each monitoring technique to various optical impairments.

articleTitle: Multiple filter functions integrated into multi-port GFF components
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: This paper demonstrates integration of multiple filter functions into a single component improving system performance and cost. Designs for producing low gain-ripple EDFAs are introduced integrating novel composite multi-port thin film GFF components.

articleTitle: CSMA/CD-Based Fiber-to-the-Desk System with Remote Repeater
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We report a fiber-to-the-desk system using carrier-sense multiple access with collision detection (CSMA/CD) and a remote repeater. The CSMA/CD is performed at the repeater to enable high channel efficiency and low-cost implementation of optical LAN.

articleTitle: Power Transients in Second Order Pumped Lumped Raman Fiber Amplifier
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present experimental and theoretical results on power transients in an all-optical gain-clamped second order pumped lumped Raman fiber amplifier. Channel addition/removal was simulated by transmitting 10 signals, light of eight lasers was square-wave modulated.

articleTitle: SPM-Induced Spectral Broadening in Bismuth-based Photonic Crystal Fiber
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Self-phase-modulation-induced spectral broadening is observed in an 46 cm-long bismuth-based nonlinear photonic crystal fiber. Numerical consideration of nonlinear pulse propagation verifies that the low dispersion and high nonlinearity are achieved simultaneously.

articleTitle: Fusion-spliceable Bi2O3-based photonic crystal fiber
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We fabricated Bi<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>-based photonic crystal fiber having the higher refractive index core. This fiber shows the fusion-spliciability to SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> fiber, relatively low loss (1.8 dB/m), high nonlinearity (780 W<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>km<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>) and small dispersion (-5 ps/nm/km) at 1550 nm.

articleTitle: Comparison of Sinusoidally Modulated Signal (SM)-SPM with CW-SPM Methods for Nonlinear Constant (n2/Aeff) Measurement of various Optical Fibers
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: It was found that the sinusoidally modulated signal based on SPM (SM-SPM) method was about 1% more accurate than CW-SPM method. Empirical equation between (n2/Aeff) and Aeff various optical fibers is proposed.

articleTitle: Micro-structured fiber end surface grating for monitoring wavelength of coarse WDM signals
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose one dimensional fiber end-surface grating fabricated by inscribing micro- structure on the cleaved surface of a thermally expanded core fiber with femtosecond laser pulses. For the monitoring of signals, the diffraction patterns according to the wavelength of input light were investigated.

articleTitle: Amplified Compression of 300-fs Er-Doped Fiber Laser Pulse to 29 fs in a Special Large-Mode-Area Er-Doped Fiber
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: All-in-one pre-chirped and amplified pulse compression of passively additive-pulse mode-locked Er-doped fiber laser from 300 to 29 fs with 10-fold pulsewidth compressing ratio by using large-mode-area and dense Er-doped fiber based optical amplifier is proposed.

articleTitle: Multi-Edge-Written Long-Period Fiber Gratings with Low PDL by Using High-frequency CO2 Laser Pulses
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A novel long-period fiber grating (LPFG) with low polarization dependent loss (PDL), for the first time to our knowledge, is fabricated by using a multi-edge exposure method with high frequency CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> laser pulses in this paper. The experimental results show that the PDL of a triple-edge-written LPFG with apeak amplitude of-16.5dB can be as low as 0.18dB. These novel LPFGs can find important applications in optical communications and sensing.

articleTitle: Quasi Single-Mode Fiber for the Cost-Effective Implementation of Broadband Access Networks
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We designed and fabricated a quasi single-mode fiber (QSMF) for the cost-effective implementation of broadband access networks. The core diameter of the fabricated QSMF was 20 μm. Using this fiber, we demonstrated the transmission of 10-Gb/s signal over 2km.

articleTitle: Visible Wavelength Emission in the Silica Glass Fiber Doped with Silicon Nano-particles
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We report realization of a novel optical fiber incorporated with Si nano-particles and its emission in the visible wavelength upon pumping at 512nm. Enhancement in 1550nm emission of the Si/Er<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup> co-doped fiber was also found.

articleTitle: 12 Channels 20GHz Programmable Integrated Optical Analog Receiver for WDM Network
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We have designed fabricated and tested a 12times20GHz programmable integrated optical analog receiver for WDM network. The analog receiver is able to receiver any of the 12 WDM channels each with a bandwidth of 20 GHz.

articleTitle: Monitoring Technique for ASE and MPI Noises in Distributed Raman Amplified Systems
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We develop a new technique for monitoring the ASE and MPI noises in a distributed Raman amplified system. The results showed that this technique, based on the polarization- nulling method, could accurately monitor these noises regardless of the bit rates, modulation formats, and OSNR levels of the signals.

articleTitle: Accumulation of Particles Near the Core During Repetitive Fiber Connector Matings and De-matings
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The increased accumulation of particles near the core during a series of mating/de-mating operations was investigated. One cause for this accumulation was ESD (electrostatic discharge) effects from cleaning. Methods to prevent this phenomenon were studied.

articleTitle: Loop-back AWG Router with Non-uniform Transmission Capacity
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We developed an AWG-based wavelength router with a loop-back structure for a system with non-uniformly distributed traffic. We describe the design of the loop-back waveguides and the transmission characteristics of the developed device.

articleTitle: Fracture Strength of Air-Clad Microstructured Fibers
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Measurement of microstructured fiber (MSF) bending strength is reported for the first time. Both coated and chemically stripped MSF are found to exhibit fracture bending strengths comparable to standard communications fiber.

articleTitle: Simultaneous Base-band and mm-Wave Delivery of Gbps data Employing Photonic Vector Modulators
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A highly scalable photonic vector modulation architecture that allows the simultaneous transmission of the digital base-band data is experimentally demonstrated generating up to 3 Gbps 8QAM signals directly at 39 GHz.

articleTitle: Multi-user asynchronous coherent OCDMA system
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Key techniques enabling asynchronous coherent OCDMA are discussed: to lower the interference level by ultra-long superstructured FBG encoder/decoder, optical thrtesholder and multi-port encoder/decoder; to enhance noise tolerance of system by forward-error-correction and differential-phase-shift-keying with balanced detection.

articleTitle: Quantifying the Dependence of Degree of Polarization on Polarization Mode Dispersion and the Optical Spectrum
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We derive a new, simple and exact DOP model that separates contributions from PMD and the optical spectrum. We use the model to derive two quantitative measures of spectral tolerance to PMD.

articleTitle: Fiber Optical Parametric Amplifier Based on a Novel LiNbO3 Synchronized double Phase Modulator
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We report the fabrication of a novel LiNbO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>-based phase modulator that allows for the simultaneous achievement of synchronous high-speed counter-phase modulation and coupling of two optical channels for fully transparent two-pump fiber optical parametric amplifier.

articleTitle: Optical Meshed Networks: From Concept to Deployment
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The paper discusses the fundamental conceptual work and the design building blocks of a meshed optical network and gives a future outlook of the next generation optical platforms.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of very high negative chromatic dispersion dual-core photonic crystal fiber
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: This paper reports the experimental drawing fabrication of very large negative chromatic dispersion dual-core photonic crystal fiber. The fabricated fiber has a peak chromatic dispersion value of -820 ps/(nm km).

articleTitle: Experimental Investigation of Adaptive Ethernet Forwarding and Optical Cut-through for Metro Optical Ethernet Networks
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present a system design for hybrid Ethernet and WDM employing commercial ethernet hardware platform, and experimentally evaluate various schemes to achieve switching between Ethernet forwarding and optical cut-through lightpaths.

articleTitle: GRID and Optical Networks: How to Bridge the Gap
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: By utilizing high-performance networks and end-systems, we show the challenges and approaches to making the underlying networking capabilities fully available to applications through impedance matching of the entire application-middleware-network execution and data paths.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Rayleigh scattering loss in photonic crystal fibers by using bi-directional OTDR measurement
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We investigate the scattering loss in photonic crystal fibers with different structures by using bi-directional OTDR measurement. Their intrinsic Rayleigh scattering coefficient is slightly less than that of conventional pure silica core single-mode fiber.

articleTitle: A Novel Scalable Multistage DWDM PON Architecture Using Cascaded Optical Interleavers With Increasing Periodicities Controlled in Central Offices
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A new multistage scheme for dense wavelength division multiplexed passive optical networks (DWDM PON) is proposed. This scheme is realized by cascading optical interleavers with increasing periodicities.
