Downstream transmission of a DWDM comb consisting of four 10 Gb/s channels is demonstrated in the proposed multistage network. We also show a scheme to provide upstream transmission. Experimental results show that this technique has the potential to support many groups of customers located at various distances from the central office.

articleTitle: High Resolution Optical Waveform and Eye Diagram Monitoring
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Techniques to analyze optical waveforms with high resolution are discussed. Emphasis is on all-optical sampling offering high resolution with excellent sensitivity. We also discuss techniques to analyze the complete optical field of high bit-rate signals.

articleTitle: 160 Gb/s RZ-DPSK OTDM-Transmission over 480 km using 160 km Repeater Spans and Advanced Forward-Error-Correction
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The advantages of using RZ-DPSK in combination with advanced forward error correction are shown in an OTDM-transmission experiment of a single-polarization 160 Gbit/s signal over 3 times 160 km dispersion managed fiber.

articleTitle: An Ultra-Compact Optical Interleaver with High Performances Based on Double-Ring Assisted Mach-Zehnder Interferometer
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present an ultra-compact and high-performance optical interleaver based on micro-ring assisted Mach-Zehnder interferometer (MZI) using ultra-high-index-contrast (UHIC) waveguide (Δn=17%). This interleaver exhibits flat and near-square passband and better than -30 dB stopband extinction ratio.

articleTitle: Widely Tunable Wavelength Conversion 10 Gb/s Using a Modulated Grating Y-branch Laser Integrated with an Optical Amplifier
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A simple integrated tunable wavelength converter is presented. 10 Gb/s XGM conversion of signals at wavelength 1530-1560 nm to 1531-1556 nm and transmission at 2.5 Gb/s over 25 km SSMF of the converted signals were achieved.

articleTitle: 1550nm Optical Interconnect Transceiver with Low Voltage Electroabsorption Modulators Flip-Chip Bonded to 90nm CMOS
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A low-voltage 90 nm CMOS optical interconnect transceiver operating at 1550 nm is presented. This is the first system demonstrated using the recent quasi-waveguide angled facet electroabsorption modulator (QWAFEM), featuring simple electronic and optical packaging.

articleTitle: Ultra-compact wavelength division multiplexing devices using silicon photonic wires for on-chip interconnects
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Ultra-compact four-channel wavelength division multiplexing (WDM) devices in add/drop filter and multi-mode interferometer configurations were demonstrated on silicon-on-insulator for future on-chip optical interconnects. Both devices show a crosstalk level ≤-13dB and a footprint ≤0.006mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>.

articleTitle: Strategies for fabricating strong-confinement microring filters and circuits
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We describe strategies for fabricating strong-confinement microring filters and circuits, and assert that techniques specifically tailored to microphotonics requirements provide a more efficient path to commercialization than techniques developed for semiconductor electronics.

articleTitle: Output-Aware Buffering with Variable Delay Buffers in Optical Packet Switching Networks
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A new buffer structure with output-aware buffering and variable delay buffer is proposed. This structure can realize optical RAM buffering in OPS contention resolution, so that it can significantly improve the performance of OPS networks.

articleTitle: Synchronization of a 160-GHz Optical Beat Signal with a 2-ps Optical RZ Signal by Phase-Locked Loop Technique
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a phase-locking of 160-GHz beat signal, which is generated by an optical comb generator and a polarization-stable, high-extinction optical filter, to a 10-Gb/s RZ signal with a residual timing jitter of 69 fs.

articleTitle: Distributed Acoustic and Seismic Sensing
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: An overview of fiber optic distributed acoustic and seismic sensor system architectures is presented.

articleTitle: Progress of Chalcogenide Glass Fibers
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: High nonlinearity and large IR transparency make these fibers well suited for compact Raman amplifiers, supercontinuum generation and other mid-IR sources. As<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> fiber has record high theoretical gain compared with silica fiber for slow-light applications.

articleTitle: Technologies for Fiber-fed 60GHz Wireless Systems
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We have investigated 60 GHz-band optoelectronic-mixers for realizing cost-effective fiber-fed 60 GHz wireless systems. Two types of optoelectronic-mixers are review: one based on cascaded semiconductor optical amplifier and electro-absorption modulator, and the other heterojunction bipolar transistors.

articleTitle: High Power Optical Amplifiers for Free-Space Communication Systems
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Emerging free-space optical communications applications require high power optical amplifiers (HPOAs) designed to differing requirements: wavelength band, modulation, polarization, and environment. Issues and performance are summarized, with emphasis on the 1.5 micron wavelength band.

articleTitle: 10Gb/s domain engineered LiNbO3 integrated electro-optic modulator for inexpensive low voltage drivers
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We report a novel single-drive 10 Gb/s electro-optic Mach-Zehnder modulator in domain inverted LiNbO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>. The low switching voltage, close to 2 V, allows the use of inexpensive drivers, such as those for electro-absorption modulators.

articleTitle: Single Chip Quad MZI array in a 40 Gb/s AOLS Front-end
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present for the first time a quadruple array of MZI switches hybrid integrated on a single chip and package used to perform error-free clock, data recovery and label extraction for 40 Gb/s packets.

articleTitle: RF-over-fiber and Optical Processing for Navy Applications
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: RF-over-fiber technology for military antenna remoting is discussed including system level metrics and examples of deployed systems. The design of a compact RF spectrum analyzer based on optical domain RF channelization is introduced.

articleTitle: Effect of Draw-Induced Residual Elastic and Inelastic Strains on Brillouin Frequency Shift in Optical Fibers
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The effect of draw-induced residual elastic and inelastic strains on Brillouin frequency shift (BFS) in optical fibers is investigated. It is found that the BFS is linearly proportional to the draw tension with -4.2 MHz/gram.

articleTitle: Study of Impact of Photonic Switch Speed on Transport Networks
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Impact of photonic switch speed on performance of transport networks is studied with a new variable switch speed test set. The results of the study generate the requirements for new "maintenance friendly" optical networks.

articleTitle: Optimal operating conditions and modulation format for 160 Gb/s signals in a fiber parametric amplifier used as a slow-light delay line element
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We study optimal operating conditions for 160-Gb/s signals traversing a slow-light delay line based on parametric amplification. Six phase modulated formats are investigated, including CSRZ, PAP-CSRZ, GAP-CSRZ, RZ duobinary, RZ DPSK and RZ.

articleTitle: High-power cw bismuth fiber laser: first results and prospects
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: CW lasing of Bi-doped fiber lasers in a wavelength range of 1150-1215 ran with output power up to 15W has been obtained for the first time. The unsaturable optical losses in Bi-doped fibers have been revealed.

articleTitle: All-Optical 2R-Regenerative Interconnection Node for DPSK Polarization-Division Multiplexed Systems
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose an all-optical 2R-regenerative interconnection node which is applied between wide area network and metro area network for DPSK polarization-division multiplexed systems with the functions of signal format conversion and signal quality improvement.

articleTitle: Millimeter-Wave Generation via Frequency Quadrupling in an Optically-Injected Optoelectronic Oscillator
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate cascaded electroabsorption-modulator-based optoelectronic oscillators (EAM-OEOs) for generating millimeter-wave signals. Low phase-noise frequency quadrupling is achieved by optically injecting 10-GHz-rate pulses from a master EAM-OEO to a 40 GHz slave EAM-OEO.

articleTitle: Short Distance Optical Connections for Home Networks, Sensing and Mobile Systems
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Singlemode and multimode glass fibers are widely used in telecommunication. This paper summarizes the wide field of applications for large diameter optical fibers, first of all the polymer optical fiber e.g. in home networks.

articleTitle: DPSK Error Correction using Multi-Bit Detection for Enhanced Sensitivity and Compensation of Impairments
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a novel, multiple-bit DPSK detection scheme, capable of correcting isolated bit errors using simple logic gates, without an increase in the transmission rate. Simulations predict a 0.4 dB back-back gain, 0.85 dB in the presence of 1 radian of nonlinear phase noise, and further increased gains in the presence of receiver impairments. A 2 dB OSNR gain is realized experimentally at a BER of le-3 using this error correction scheme.

articleTitle: Managing Fiber Connections in NGN and Applications
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Increasing fiber applications such as DWDM, Ultra Long Haul and FTTH are rapidly taxing manually managed fiber infrastructure. New fiber management technologies and architectures are evaluated to meet the growth of emerging networks and applications.

articleTitle: Efficient BER estimation for Radio-over-Fiber systems
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present a novel BER estimation method for sub-carrier multiplexed signals using QAM modulation that accounts for noise and intermodulation distortions. It is of particular interest for the design and optimization of radio-over-fiber systems.

articleTitle: Broadband Access Technologies for FTTx Deployment
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: This paper describes GPON applications using both all fiber and fiber/DSL mix for cost savings. Transporting multiple broadband services over the metro and core network is described for differentiated services.

articleTitle: Long-Term Wavelength Reliability in Semi-Cooled 11.1 Gbps-80 km EAM-LDs for DWDM XFPs
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We have developed semi-cooled 11.1 Gbps-80 km EAM-LDs optimized for long-term wavelength reliability for DWDM applications. Estimated MTTF over 105 hours to 100 pm wavelength drift was demonstrated for the first time.

articleTitle: Multilayer 3-D Photonics in Silicon
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Three-dimensionally integrated devices have been realized in silicon using SIMOX 3D sculpting. Devices are fabricated, for the first time, on three vertically-integrated silicon layers, paving the way towards ultra-dense opto-electronic structures in silicon.

articleTitle: A Synchronous All-optical 160 Gb/s Photonic Interconnection Network
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A modular photonic interconnection network based on a combination of basic 2 x 2 all-optical nodes is presented. The proposed architecture is synchronous, can operate up to 160 Gb/s and exhibits self-routing capability and very low switching latency.

articleTitle: Petabit-per-Second Routers: Case for All-Optical over Electronic Implementation
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: This paper investigates merits and challenges of all-optical routers. All-optical routers can exploit the wavelength domain not available in electronic routers to overcome the lack of optical buffers, and to realize compact ultralow power systems.

articleTitle: High-Speed Wavelength Tuning of Tunable Distributed Amplification DFB-LD in Long Haul Transmission
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We clarified for the first time the influence of tuning current noise on linewidth broadening and transmission for TDA-DFB-LD. Suppressing noise at higher frequencies, we demonstrated 300-ns high-speed wavelength switching without degradations in 80-km transmission.

articleTitle: Asynchronous Digital Optical Regenerator by an EAM-loop for 4 × 40Gb/s WDM to 160Gb/s OTDM Conversion
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose an asynchronous-digital-optical-regenerator by using a single EAM-loop with neighbour-combine-gate approach. It effectively regenerates signal with high amplitude fluctuation, re-shapes and re-times pulses for 4 x 40Gb/s WDM to 160Gb/s OTDM conversion.

articleTitle: Proposal of a Novel MMI-Based NxN Non-Blocking Optical Ring Switch
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose a novel optical NxN switch network based on MMI elements and a nested rings topology. Reductions compared to the conventional Beneš breves network include the number of switching elements, power consumption, and physical device area. As much as 20% reduction to the number of elements is achievable for an NxN switch. An equation has also been derived for the number of switches. Since MMI elements in this type of device are required to operate with bi-directional inputs, passive simulation shows that they can exhibit low losses of 0.1dB with -52dB of crosstalk.

articleTitle: Stabilized Optical Frequency Comb Source for Coherent Communication and Signal Processing
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A semiconductor based, low noise mode-locked laser with 195 10.24 GHz spaced stabilized optical frequencies and a pulse timing jitter (1 Hz-100 MHz) of 11.4 fs for optical communication applications is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Light-Induced Self-Written three-dimensional polymer optical waveguide for module fabrication and interconnection
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Light-induced self-written (LISW) technology is a unique and simple method of forming low-loss 3-dimensional optical circuits in a photopolymer solution. By using this technology, we fabricated and tested a WDM optical module.

articleTitle: Performance and Design Guidelines for Silicon-Based Micro-ring Modulators in 10 Gbits/s Systems
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We show key design guidelines for three types of micro-ring modulators. We find that: (i) the dual-waveguide structure can have a 10-dB higher Q and is tolerant to long transit times, (ii) the induced peak shift can have an optimal value, and (iii) detuning before transmission can decrease penalty 10 dB further.

articleTitle: Carrier-Grade Ethernet for Core Networks
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: This paper considers the functionality and standards required to enable carrier-grade core networks based on Ethernet-over-WDM. Possible Ethernet backbone network architectures will be discussed followed by an evaluation of the CAPEX and OPEX performance.

articleTitle: Engineering a Scalable and Bandwidth Elastic Next Generation PON
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We engineer and simulate the scalability and bandwidth elasticity of a next generation PON. Our scalable PON hierarchically combines WDM and TDM, and it connects 16,000 end-users with elastic bandwidth on demand with high performance.

articleTitle: Ultrafast all-optical differentiators for generation of orthogonal (sub-) picosecond Hermite-Gaussian waveforms
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A novel reconfigurable technique for higher-order temporal differentiation of ultrafast optical waveforms is proposed. Using this method, we experimentally demonstrate efficient generation of temporally orthogonal second and third-order Hermite-Gaussian waveforms in the (sub-)picosecond regime.

articleTitle: Variable Bit Rate Optical CDMA Networks Using Multiple Pulse Position Modulation
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We have demonstrated multiple-pulse position modulation to achieve a variable bit rate OCDMA system, operating at different bit rates of 2.5, 4.3, and 5.7 Gbps, without changing pulse- width, encoders/decoders, and utilized bandwidth.

articleTitle: Polarization Echoes Based on Scatter De-correlation in Polarization Maintaining Fiber
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: High-resolution optical frequency domain reflectometry is used to observe fading of the polarization beat signature of PM fiber. Through dispersion management, a beat echo is observed at a later point in a fiber under test.

articleTitle: Suppression of ASE noise in the signal band by the spectral spread technique
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose a novel method of suppressing the in-band ASE noise from optical amplifiers by means of the spectral spread technique. The receiver-sensitivity improvement of 1.5 dB is demonstrated experimentally by using our scheme.

articleTitle: Backup Reprovisioning after Shared Risk Link Group (SRLG) Failures in Survivable WDM Mesh Networks
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Compared to single-link failures, SRLG failures will leave much more connections vulnerable to next failures. We investigate benefits of backup reprovisioning after SRLG failures and evaluate different policies for backup reprovisioning.

articleTitle: Optical Burst and Transient Equalizer for 10Gb/s Amplified WDM-PON
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose and demonstrate an optical-burst-and-transient-equalizer (OBTE) on silicon-on-insulator (SOI) to provide a compact and low-cost solution to compensate gain- transient, gain-spectrum-tilt and to equalize the upstream packets amplitude in EDFA-amplified WDM-PON.

articleTitle: Carrier Ethernet: A Reality Check
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: This paper provides a current assessment of Carrier Ethernet from a service provider perspective. It highlights the drivers and key attributes of Carrier Ethernet and discusses some remaining gaps and challenges.

articleTitle: Multi-Rate Spectral Phase-Encoded Time-Spreading Optical CDMA System Using OVSF Code Sequences
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose a multi-rate SPECTS-O-CDMA system using OVSF code sequences. The proposed multi-rate system achieves a distinct differentiation on bit-rate/BER requirements and improves the BER performances of higher-rate users compared to the conventional single-rate system.

articleTitle: Ultra-Compact Long-Period Fiber Grating and Grating Pair Fabrication using a Modulation-Scanned CO2 Laser
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A new method to inscribe a long-period grating (LPG) with strong grating (>25 dB loss), short grating length (1.2 cm) and low insertion loss (<1.0 dB) by using a programmable sinusoidal-dithering, linearly scanned CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> laser beam is reported.

articleTitle: Detection Sensitivity of Brillouin Sensors Located Near Fresnel Reflection
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: This paper discusses the effect of Fresnel reflection on BOTDR measurement. We show that a detectable sensor length can be determined from the intensity of the returning light and it depends on the laser linewidth.

articleTitle: First Demonstration of Clockless Serial Optical Code Label Switching with SSFBGs Label Recognizer
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We proposed and demonstrated 40Gbps, 256-label optical packet switching employing a clockless serial optical code label processing. Eight different SSFBGs label recognizers with high auto- to cross-correlation peak ratio were used for optical label correlation.

articleTitle: Realization of All-fiber Tunable Filter & High Optical Power Blocker Using Thinned Fiber Bragg Gratings Coated with Carbon Nanotubes
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Using thinned fiber Bragg gratings coated with carbon nanotubes, we demonstrate that the reflection band can be controlled by the in-line optical power. We use the structure to realize an all-fiber tunable filter and a high optical power blocker.

articleTitle: Temperature insensitive bending sensor based on a sampled fiber Bragg grating
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose and experimentally demonstrate a simple and practical scheme for temperature insensitive bending sensor based on a single sampled chirped fiber Bragg grating with multiple resonant peaks, which is embedded in a flexible cantilever beam.

articleTitle: A novel scheme to generate 100Gbit/s DQPSK signal with large PMD tolerance
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A novel 100 Gbit/s transmitter has been proposed and experimentally demonstrated. It can tolerate over 20 ps DGD. After transmission over 300 km conventional SMF, the power penalty is 0.7 dB.

articleTitle: Full-duplex Wireless GbE Field Trial Employing Radio-over-Fiber Technologies
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A full-duplex radio-over fiber system for the transmission of Gigabit Ethernet signals in the mm-wave band has been demonstrated under a field trial, providing redundant connections and point-to-point wireless extension of optical GbE networks.

articleTitle: 3 Fiber Line Switched Ring
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: This paper describes a new optical network ring protection scheme, which leads to increased revenue and flexibility compared to existing protection schemes of 2 fiber BLSR/MS-spring and 4 fiber BLSR/MS-spring.

articleTitle: All-Optical Signal Processing Devices with (Periodically Poled) Lithium Niobate Waveguides
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Integrated optical Lithium Niobate devices for all-optical signal processing in the 1.5 μm wavelength range are reviewed. Besides nonlinear devices with periodically poled waveguides tunable Ti:Er:LiNbO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> waveguide lasers are presented. Novel waveguide structures are reported.

articleTitle: Possible Future Applications of Photonic Bandgap Fiber in Non-Repeatered Transmission Systems
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We investigate the potential use of photonic bandgap fibers in non repeatered transmission systems. Our simulations show that significant improvements in system reach should be possible as a result of the reduced nonlinearity providing that the fiber losses can be reduced to the 0.2 to 0.3dB/km regime.

articleTitle: Quantum-Noise-Randomized Data Encryption: Comparative Analysis of M-ary PSK and M-ary ASK Protocols for Long-Haul Optical Communications
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: An M-ary PSK protocol for quantum-noise randomized encryption enables 10 Gb/s encrypted data transmission over 5000 km in dispersion-compensated fiber links, which is 7 times longer than using an equivalent ASK protocol in the same data links.

articleTitle: Demonstration of 1000km 43Gb/s RZ-DPSK Transmission through a 50GHz Channel Spaced WSS
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate bandwidth-limited 1000 km transmission of 43 Gb/s RZ-DPSK signals. System bandwidth was limited via a MEMS-based wavelength-selective switch operating at 50 GHz channel spacing. The system demonstrates increased tolerance to bandwidth limitation, noise and non- linearity.

articleTitle: Simultaneous Slow-Light Delay and Pulse Reshaping of 10Gbps RZ Data in Highly Nonlinear Fiber-based Optical Parametric Amplifier with Clock-Modulated Pump
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: In this paper, the authors demonstrate 25ps slow-light delay of 10Gbps RZ data simultaneously with pulsewidth reshaping from 50ps to 20ps using optical parametric amplifier. Error-free operations are achieved for both 10Gbps RZ packets and PRBS data.

articleTitle: Robust gain control scheme of EDFA based reconfigurable OADM for WDM Metro applications
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A simple and efficient gain control scheme for EDFA based reconfigurable OADM dedicated to metro applications is proposed. Each pair of input-output amplifiers is gain clamped by single control channel @ 1532 nm which bypasses the ROADM node structure.

articleTitle: Using signal processing technologies from the Radio Frequency domain in optics
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The possibilities of bandwidth-efficiency improvements of optical communication systems by adoption of signal processing technologies, such as multiple sub-carrier modulation, equalization, CDMA and MIMO, from radio frequency domain into optics is discussed.

articleTitle: High-Capacity Data Transport via Large-Core Plastic Optical Fiber Links using Quadrature Amplitude Modulation
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Low-cost QAM chip sets enable high-capacity data transport over highly-dispersive POF links. The feasibility of QAM-64 and -256 system implementation options is shown. Wavelength-sliced QAM-64 performs the best regarding bandwidth consumption and link power budget.

articleTitle: Novel local liquid-core single-mode fiber for dispersion engineering using submicron tapered fiber
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A capillary is threaded with a submicron-tapered-fiber and then stretched. The stretched capillary, serving as a new cladding, with submicron-tapered-fiber inside is infiltrated with optical liquid, acting as a new core, for novel dispersion engineering.

articleTitle: PRBS data delay in an all fiber slow light system based on SBS effect, NRZ vs. RZ
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We study the data delay effect in a fiber SBS slow light system. The results show that, with the same pump configuration, NRZ has a larger delay and better eye opening than RZ format.

articleTitle: Design and fabrication of ferroelectric all-polymer hollow Bragg fibers for THz guidance
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Hollow Bragg fiber operating near ferroelectric resonance of one of its reflector materials is considered. Depending upon operating frequency, lowest loss design is: a band gap fiber, fiber with metamaterial reflector or a ferroelectric tube.

articleTitle: Low Loss Wavelength Monitor with Sub-picometer Resolution Based on Tilted Fiber Gratings
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A wavelength monitor based on a pair of tilted fiber Bragg gratings with low insertion loss (<1 dB) and sub-picometer wavelength resolution is reported.

articleTitle: Experimental Demonstration of an Optical-Label-Switching Router Architecture Supporting Selective 3R Regeneration
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose an optical-label-switching router architecture that utilizes selective-3R to offer regeneration in a smart and efficient way with only limited 3R capability. The experiment demonstrates error-free operation of selective-3R with all-optical burst-mode clock recovery.

articleTitle: Single-reflection-band fiber Bragg gratings with channelized linear and nonlinear dispersion and their applications
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present a new class of multi-channel Fiber Bragg grating, which provides the characteristics of channelized dispersion but does so with only a single reflection band. Such gratings can provide pure phase control of optical pulses without introducing any deleterious insertion-loss-variation.

articleTitle: Recent Advances in Germanium Quantum Well Structures - A New Modulation Mechanism for Silicon-Compatible Optics
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Silicon technology increasingly can implement both electronics and optics for communications. The recent discovery of strong electroabsorption in Ge quantum wells on silicon may fill a key gap, allowing a merged technology for many applications.

articleTitle: Experimental Demonstration of a Label-Switched and 50GHz Channel Spacing DWDM Network with 50Gb/s DQPSK Payload and 3.125Gb/s inversion-RZ OOK Label
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We have successfully demonstrated that an inversion-RZ pulse signal can be employed in a 50Gbit/s RZ-DQPSK payload per channel and 50GHz channel spacing optical packet switching network as an orthogonal modulation optical label. This inversion-RZ optical label is generated by a novel and simple scheme.

articleTitle: Cascaded operation of a 2R burst-mode regenerator with data exhibiting 6 dB power variation
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Cascaded operation of a single SOA-MZI 2R burst-mode regenerator is demonstrated using a novel loop configuration that induces a per-loop 6 dB power variation on the recirculating data. Error-free operation is achieved for four successive loops.

articleTitle: High-Gain Optical Amplification of Europium-Aluminum Nanocluster Doped Planar Polymer Waveguides
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We have successfully demonstrated optical amplification using a planar PMMA (polymethylmethacrylate) optical waveguide with doped Eu-Al nanoclusters. The optical gain of 5.57dB/mm was observed while well suppressing the concentration quenching. copy2006 Optical Society of America

articleTitle: Ultra-fast Clock Recovery Based on Pre-embedded Sub-harmonic Clock in Optical Burst/Packet Networks
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose an ultra-fast clock recovery technique for the use in the optical burst/packet networks, and evaluated its performance by using 40-Gb/s burst-mode NRZ and DPSK signals.

articleTitle: Semiconductor based demultiplexer and wavelength conversion at 320 Gbits/sec
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate error-free 320 Gb/s SOA based optical time-domain demultiplexing and wavelength conversion. It is pointed out that ultrafast optical gating (1.8 ps) can be realized by using a single SOA and a detuned optical band-pass filter

articleTitle: Monolithic Add-Drop Quantum Dot Switch Exhibiting Ultra-Low Cross-Wavelength Distortion
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A monolithic add-drop switch incorporating an InGaAs quantum-dot active layer is presented, and 10Gb/s dual wavelength operation is demonstrated. No impairment in device performance is observed as a result

articleTitle: Continuously FSR tunable all fiber Fabry-Perot filter and its application to tunable multiwavelength SOA ring laser
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We investigate a simple and flexible scheme of all fiber Fabry-Perot filter with continuous free spectral range tunability and its application to a multiwavelength SOA laser with eleven lasing channels at room temperature.

articleTitle: Feasibility of Flow-Based Optical Provisioning in GÈANT
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present a novel network architecture that establishes dynamic optical paths by analyzing local network traffic. We demonstrate its feasibility and effectiveness through a network analysis using real traces collected from the pan-European GEANT network.

articleTitle: Single-mode air-guiding photonic bandgap fiber with improved broadband transmission characteristics: The benefits of an anti-resonant core design
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The condition for single-mode operation in photonic band-gap fibers (PBGFs) is investigated. If the silica-ring satisfies an anti-resonant condition, the PBGF with a realistic core exhibits a single-mode operation over a wide wavelength range.

articleTitle: Demonstration of 16-user OCDMA over 3-wavelength WDM using 511-chip, 640 Gchip/s SSFBG en/decoder and single light source
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We experimentally demonstrated 16-user OCDMA over 3-wavelength, 100-GHz spacing WDM system using 640 Gchip/s super-structured FBG en/decoder and single light source, with the frequency interval far narrower than 640GHz.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of 2D photonic crystal surface cavity in amorphous silicon on silica structure
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Design, fabrication, and characterization of an optical filter based on side coupling between silicon wire waveguide and photonic crystal surface mode cavity in silicon on silica structure is presented for the 1550 nm wavelength spectral region.

articleTitle: Fabrication of Cascaded Perpendicular Up Tapers for Si-Wire Waveguides
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A new type of spot-size converter (SSC) is proposed for efficient coupling between a single-mode fiber and a silicon wire waveguide with cross section of 0.3&;0.3μm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. Desirable mode expansion was confirmed numerically and experimentally.

articleTitle: Multilayer Routing on Restricted Path for Traffic in IP over DWDM Networks
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Multilayer routing on restricted path (MRRP) was proposed, which confines the traffic only choose network resource on the restricted path. Discrete event simulation (DES) shows that MRRP has lower blocking probability and resource occupation.

articleTitle: Resiliency of OCDM-PON against near-far problem
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Resiliency of OCDM-PON is investigated through theoretical and numerical simulation. A 32-ONU system can achieve BER=10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-9</sup> and overcome the near-far problem when synchronous operation, power leveling, and LDPC error correction are used.

articleTitle: SPECTS O-CDMA 80.8-km BOSSNET Field Trial using a Compact, Fully Integrated, AWG-Based Encoder/Decoder
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The authors demonstrate successful encoding and decoding of SPECTS O-CDMA signals using a compact, fully integrated, AWG-based encoder/decoder. The signal is recovered in the presence of an interferer after transmission across an 80.8-km BOSSNET link.

articleTitle: Gbps-Rate Channel Translation from Near-Infrared to Visible Band
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate the translation of Gbps channel from the conventional fiber communication band to the visible band. Signal channel is converted over 1000 nm using four-photon process in photonic crystal fiber. An error-free received performance was measured in the target visible band.

articleTitle: Multi-wavelength light source for OCDMA using a directly sinusoidally modulated laser diode
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: For OCDMA, a novel flattened multi-wavelength light source scheme that is based on a directly sinusoidally modulated laser diode technique is proposed. Its performance is confirmed experimentally; its support of OCDMA is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Soft-Decoding of Low-Density Parity Check Codes for DPSK Signals
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The exact log-likelihood ratio for a direct-detection DPSK signal is derived analytically. A 7%-overhead low-density parity check (LDPC) code provides 9.7 dB net coding gain.

articleTitle: 1.3 and 1.55-μm InP-based VCSELs for digital and radio signal transmission
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: High performance InP-based LW-VCSELs have been realized. 10-Gbit/s error-free transmission was achieved up to 85°C as well as under high reflection. Polarization-stable operation was achieved using misoriented substrates. LW-VCSELs can be used for radio-over-fiber application.

articleTitle: A Novel Tunable DeMUX/MUX Solution for WSS-Based ROADM and WXC Nodes
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We introduce the applications and technologies of tunable demultiplexers/multiplexers (DeMUX/MUX) in wavelength division multiplexing (WDM) networks. We also propose a novel solution using fixed waveband filters to achieve similar provisioning flexibility and reduced control complexity.

articleTitle: Compact Focusing Grating Couplers Between Optical Fibers and Silicon-on-Insulator Photonic Wire Waveguides
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present compact and broadband grating couplers in silicon-on-insulator, between single-mode fiber and nanophotonic waveguides. Curved gratings allow for a very short transition between wide waveguides and photonic wires, resulting in very compact devices.

articleTitle: Cross comparison of the nonlinear impairments caused by 10Gbit/s neighboring channels on a 40Gbit/s channel modulated with various formats, and over various fiber types
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We evaluate the impact of lOGbit/s NRZ channels on the performance of one 40 Gbit/s PSBT, DQPSK or DPSK channel over two fiber types. DPSK and PSBT are much less affected by 10 Gbit/s neighbors than DQPSK.

articleTitle: 40 Gb/s Low-drive-voltage LiNbO3 Optical Modulator for DQPSK Modulation Format
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Low-drive-voltage (3.5 V) and uniform modulation characteristics of MZIs were achieved with Z-cut dual-drive nested-MZIs structure and the wide-gap design between signal and ground electrodes, resulting in precise constellation mappings in 43 Gb/s DQPSK modulation.

articleTitle: Photonic Microwave Filter with Negative Coefficients Based on Cross Polarization Modulation in a Semiconductor Optical Amplifier
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A novel approach to implementing a photonic microwave filter with negative coefficients based on cross polarization modulation in a semiconductor optical amplifier is proposed. A two-tap microwave bandpass filter with one negative coefficient is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Amplification of Optical Bursts in Gain-Stabilized Erbium-Doped Optical Amplifier
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Optical-burst amplification in a gain-stabilized-amplifier may generate complex gain dynamics with chaotic behavior. This phenomenon is thoroughly investigated using a theoretical model and dedicated experiments. Optimized device designs to avoid optical-burst transmission impairments are proposed.

articleTitle: The Photonic Bottleneck
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: By analyzing the basic physics of all-optical processes, we show that all-optical networks will suffer a "photonic bottleneck" due to the fundamental properties of photons.

articleTitle: Standards Compliance Testing of Optical Transmitters Using a Software-Based Equalizing Reference Receiver
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Incorporation of EDC technology in optical networking presents new challenges in developing tests for transmitter standards compliance. This paper describes the 10 GBASE-LRM TWDP test, recently adopted for 10 Gbps Ethernet links over dispersive multimode fiber.

articleTitle: Multiple Failure Recovery of Optical Paths Using GMPLS Based Restoration Scheme Escalation
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: This paper proposes a generalized multi-protocol label switching based restoration scheme escalation against multiple failures. The proposed scheme automatically evolves from a pre-planned restoration scheme to a label switched path rerouting scheme following the failure state in a network.

articleTitle: A Cost-Effective WDM-PON Configuration Employing Innovative Bi-directional Amplification
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Novel bi-directional amplifier is employed in a WDM-PON system to increase power margin for both downstream and upstream signals. After 100-km SSMF transmission, the power-penalty for all channels at 10Gbit/s is less than 0.8 dB.

articleTitle: Ultra-compact reconfigurable silicon optical devices using micron-scale localized thermal heating
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Novel design of a compact low-loss and high-efficiency micro-heater is demonstrated for silicon photonic wire ultra-compact reconfigurable devices. Highly localized heating enables reduced thermal crosstalk for densely packed, individually addressable cascaded devices.

articleTitle: ROADM Deployment, Challenges, and Applications
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: In this paper, we discuss deployment challenges for reconfigurable optical add/drop multiplexers (ROADMs). After an overview of the architecture, we discuss the issues we have experienced in the course of our deployments. We end with recommendations for those planning to deploy ROADM in the future.

articleTitle: Comparison of Two Carrier Phase Estimation Schemes in Optical Coherent Detection Systems
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We compare the performance of two carrier-phase-estimation schemes, the decision- feedback and the Mth power schemes. We discuss the advantages and disadvantages of the two schemes in terms of performance limit, laser-linewidth tolerance, and polarization tracking.

articleTitle: A 40 Gb/s Asynchronous Optical Packet Buffer Based on an SOA Gate Matrix for Contention Resolution
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a 40 Gb/s optical packet buffer with asynchronous and autonomous control for use in contention resolution. Layer-2 (packet recovery) measurements are presented with less than 1 dB power penalty up to 10 circulations.

articleTitle: Linear-distortion compensation using XPM with parabolic pulses
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a novel all-optical, all-fiberized scheme that can eliminate linear perturbations in the time domain. The technique relies on converting these distortions from time to frequency domain using parabolic pulses shaped using SSFBG.

articleTitle: Modal control of a 50μm core diameter multimode fiber using a spatial light modulator
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: An iterative, self-correcting system for doing modal control using adaptive optics in a 50μm core diameter multimode fiber (MMF) is designed. It is shown experimentally to reduce the number of modes generated by 300%.

articleTitle: Dynamic Behavior of Spectral Hole Burning in EDFA with 980nm Pumping
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: EDFA dynamic behavior is studied with respect to the influence of spectral hole burning on surviving channel power. Simulation results are compared with measurements and importance of new 3-level EDFA model with SHB is demonstrated.

articleTitle: All-Channel PMD Mitigation Using Distributed Fast Polarization Scrambling in WDM Systems with FEC
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We review the progresses on the simultaneous PMD mitigation for all channels in a WDM system with FEC using distributed fast polarization scrambling. The benefits and implementation considerations of this PMD mitigation technique are discussed.

articleTitle: First Field Trial of OLS Network Testbed with All-Optical Contention Resolution of Asynchronous, Variable-Length Optical Packets
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate field trial of asynchronous, variable-length packet contention resolution at data-rate of 10-Gb/s in an OLS network testbed built with in-ground field fiber. Both the lab-test and the field trial results indicate error-free operation.

articleTitle: Polarization Independent All-Optical Retiming Based on Cross-Phase Modulation and Spectral Slicing
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Polarization independent all-optical retiming is demonstrated experimentally at 10 Gb/s using a self-pulsating DFB laser and cross-phase modulation in a highly nonlinear fiber. Regardless of its state-of-polarization, the timing jitter of retimed data signal is less than 2 ps. copy2006 Optical Society of America

articleTitle: A Protection Method for Ring-Type TDM-PONs against Fiber Fault
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A new self-protected ring-based time-division-multiplexed passive optical network (TDM-PON) with dual-fiber path against the fiber-fault in the fiber access system is proposed and investigated experimentally.

articleTitle: 43Gb/s Adaptive Polarization Mode Dispersion Compensator Field Trial
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We describe long-term field measurements at 43Gb/s over a high-PMD link, using one receiver with adaptive PMD compensation and a second receiver without. The Q at both receivers is monitored and correlated with instantaneous DGD.

articleTitle: Vector signal transmission in ROF system employing optical carrier-suppressed modulation scheme
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: For the first time, optical carrier-suppressed modulation scheme is employed to transmit vector signals in ROF system. Advantages of simple structure, doubled radio frequency and dispersion immunity are demonstrated by theoretical analysis and experiments.

articleTitle: A Novel Technique for Low-Cost Embedded Non-intrusive Fiber Monitoring of P2MP Optical Access Networks
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A low cost embedded OTDR method is presented for monitoring the fiber plant of TDM optical networks without extra optical components nor performance penalty. It localizes abrupt changes in link attenuation without disturbing network operation.

articleTitle: Iterative Electronic Equalization Utilizing Low Complexity MLSEs for 40 Gbit/s DQPSK Modulation
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present simulations of a novel electronic signal processing technique that allows digital equalization of optical 40Gbit/s DQPSK signals using iterative equlization with mutual exchange of information between low complexity MLSEs.

articleTitle: 1,000-km transmission of 20-Gbit/s QPSK-NRZ co-polarized DWDM signals with spectral efficiency of 1 bit/s/Hz using coherent detection
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate co-polarized 20-Gbit/s DWDM NRZ-QPSK transmission over 1074 km using a phasephase-diversity optical homodyne receiver. The spectral efficiency is as high as 1.05 bit/s/Hz, which is limited by cross-phase modulation between DWDM channels.

articleTitle: Analysis of Crosstalk in Mixed 43 Gb/s RZ-DQPSK and 10.7 Gb/s DWDM Systems at 50 GHz Channel Spacing
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: In DWDM field experiments over 1047 km of standard fiber and in simulations we analyze the impact of crosstalk on a 43 Gb/s RZ-DQPSK channel both by 10.7 Gb/s OOK and 43 Gb/s RZ-DQPSK neighbors at 50 GHz channel spacing.

articleTitle: 10 Gb/s Wavelength-Tunable EML with Continuous Wavelength Tuning Covering 50 GHz × 8 Channels on ITU Grid
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A wavelength-tunable EA-modulated laser (wavelength-tunable EML) using tunable distributed amplification (TDA) structure was demonstrated. An 80 km transmission of 10 Gb/s signals was confirmed on 8 channels on ITU grid using the device's simple, continuous tuning mechanism.

articleTitle: Waveband MUX/DEMUX Using Concatenated AWGs -Formulation of Waveguide Connection and Fabrication
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Recently we proposed a new waveband MUX/DEMUX that uses two concatenated AWGs. We formulate how to connect the two AWGs. We fabricate the device using silica PLC technology and experimentally confirm its feasibility.

articleTitle: Effects of Downstream Modulation Formats on the Performance of BidirectionalWDM-PON using RSOA
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We evaluate the effects of the downstream modulation formats (NRZ, IRZ, and Manchester) on the performance of the RSOA-based bidirectional WDM-PON. The results show that, by using Manchester format, the performances of upstream signals become insensitive to the operating conditions of RSOA.

articleTitle: On using optical-layer link information parameters in distributed impairment constraint-based routing
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Impairments are a major issue in transparent networks. Impairment-aware routing (ICBR) proposals require complex analytical models that are unsuitable in distributed environments. We propose an aggregation method to obtain optical-layer link parameters for distributed ICBR.

articleTitle: A Novel Load Balancing Deflection Routing Strategy in Optical Burst Switching Networks
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A novel load balancing deflection routing algorithm is proposed to provide optimized alternative routing path selection. Simulations show that the burst drop probability is significantly reduced compared to traditional deflection routing strategy.

articleTitle: 1.1-μm-range tunnel junction VCSELs with 27-GHz relaxation oscillation frequency
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We have developed novel 1.1-μm-range InGaAs VCSELs with buried type-II tunnel junctions for high-speed optical interconnections. A relaxation oscillation frequency of 27 GHz was achieved. Error-free 30-Gbps operations were demonstrated using directly modulated multi-mode VCSELs.

articleTitle: 1 Gsymbol/s, 64 QAM coherent optical transmission over 150 km with a spectral efficiency of 3 bit/s/Hz
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A 1 Gsymbol/s, 64 QAM coherent signal was successfully transmitted over 150 k m using heterodyne detection with a frequency-stabilized fiber laser and an optical phase-locked-loop technique. The spectral efficiency reached as high as 3 bit/s/Hz.

articleTitle: First demonstration of end-to-end inter-domain lightpath provisioning using GMPLS E-NNI between US and Japan for high-end data and Grid services
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Dynamic path provisioning of 1OGbE using GMPLS E-NNI was successfully achieved between Japan and the US for the first time. Without exposing routing topology of individual network domains, end-to-end optical circuits were established via PXCs.

articleTitle: An Ultra-Long-Distance FBG Sensor System Based on a Tunable Fiber Ring Laser Configuration
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A novel tunable fiber ring laser configuration with multi-stage hybrid Raman/EDF amplification is first proposed and demonstrated for realizing an ultra-long-distance (~100 km) fiber Bragg grating (FBG) sensing system with a high optical SNR of >50 dB.

articleTitle: Measurement of tolerance to non-uniform burst powers in SOA amplified GPON systems
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We investigate the performance of an amplified GPON system under conditions of unequal burst powers from ONTs. Successful operation is shown for power differences up to 14 dB as might be expected in a deployed system.

articleTitle: Flexibility in Access Networks : a Novel WDMA/TDMA Scheme for Passive Optical Networks
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose a new access network scheme introducing WDM based flexibility, with dynamic rearrangement of customer connections. We focus on physical layer issues, simulation and experimental results are provided for a network without optical amplification.

articleTitle: Wide temperature (15°C to 95°C), 80-km SMF transmission of a 1.55-μm, 10-Gbit/s InGaAlAs electroabsorption modulator integrated DFB laser
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Uncooled 10-Gbit/s, 80- km SMF transmission was demonstrated for the first time using a 1.55-μm InGaAlAs EA/DFB laser. A power penalty below 2-dB was achieved over a wide temperature range from 15°C to 95°C.

articleTitle: Fast control of inter-channel SRS and residual EDFA transients using a multiple-wavelength forward-pumped discrete Raman amplifier
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose to use a forward-pumped discrete Raman amplifier with a linear feed-forward pump control algorithm to compensate accumulated inter-channel SRS and residual EDFA transients. The method was shown to perform well in both static and dynamic experiments.

articleTitle: Decagonal Photonic Crystal Fibers with Ultra-Flattened Chromatic Dispersion and Low Confinement Loss
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Decagonal PCFs with extremely low dispersion of 0 ± 0.26 ps/(nm-.km) in the wavelength range of 1.40 μm to 1.60 μm with confinement loss less than 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-6</sup>dB/km is presented

articleTitle: All-Optical Wavelength Conversion using Multi-Pump Raman-assisted Four-Wave Mixing
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We reported all-optical wavelength conversion using multi-pump Raman-assisted four-wave mixing. All-optical wavelength conversion with 10 nm bandwidth of flat conversion efficiency is achieved. The measured power penalty is ~1 dB for 10 Gb/s down-converted signals for detunes of 5 and 10 nm at BER of 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-9</sup>.

articleTitle: Ultra-broadband quantum-dot semiconductor optical amplifier and its applications
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We have developed an ultra-broadband InAs/InGaAsP quantum-dot semiconductor optical amplifier around 1520 nm with the 3-dB bandwidth of 150 nm. The four-wave mixing process and multi-wavelength lasers have been demonstrated by using our QD-SOAs.

articleTitle: Provision of Independent Services in WDM-Passive Optical Networks using Closely Separated Dual Baseband Channels
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a simple scheme for the generation and separation of two independent high bandwidth baseband optical channels using a single laser and modulator for provision of independent services in WDM passive optical networks.

articleTitle: Novel Redundancy Design Methodology for an Optimal PON Protection Architecture
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: we present novel redundancy methodology to design a survivable PON and demonstrate the efficiency of our redundancy methodology by analyzing the performance of derived protection architecture in terms of availability and cost perspective.

articleTitle: Transmission of Multilevel 60 Gbit/s Polarization Multiplexed RZ-D8PSK using only 10 Gbit/s equipment
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: By combining differential 8-ary phase shift keying with polarization multiplexing, we present transmission of multilevel modulation with 6 bits per symbol through a 100 km fiber span with a receiver bit-error-ratio better than 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-9</sup>.

articleTitle: Non-linear Equalizers in Narrowband Filter Receiver achieving 950 ps/nm Residual Dispersion Tolerance for 40Gb/s Optical MSK Transmission Systems
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose non-linear equalizers that extend the reach of dispersion tolerance of 40Gb/s optical MSK transmission systems to ±952ps/nm and ±884 ps/nm at BER = 1e-9 with required OSNR of 23.5dB and 19dB respectively.

articleTitle: All-Optical Packet Switching by Pulsed-Pump Wavelength Exchange in a Highly Nonlinear Dispersion-Shifted Fiber
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate experimentally for the first time successful switching of packets based on wavelength exchange with two pulsed pumps located at the anomalous-dispersion region. Simultaneous packet switching between different wavelengths at same timeslot is achieved.

articleTitle: Network Management Solution for PS/PON, WDM/PON and Hybrid PS/WDM/PON using DS-OCDM
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A novel network management solution for PS/PON, WDM/PON and PS/WDM/PON is proposed and developed. Modified DS-OCDM overcomes OTDR shortcomings and capacity limitation of known PON management techniques for standard and advanced PON architectures.

articleTitle: Improved label property of orthogonal ASK/DPSK labeling by using a 40 Gb/s Manchester coded payload
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate an orthogonal ASK/DPSK labeling using a 40 Gb/s Manchester coded payload and a 2.5 Gb/s DPSK label. The extinction ration can be increased to 11 dB resulting in 8 dB improvement for the label sensitivity.

articleTitle: Fiber amplifier performance in γ-radiation environment
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Fiber based amplifiers are being considered for use on low earth orbiting (LEO) satellites for next generation communication systems. This paper deals with evaluation of the performance of an Er/Yb based fiber amplifier in γ-radiation environment.

articleTitle: Experimental study of XPM in 10-Gb/s NRZ pre-compensated transmission systems
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We experimentally assess the nonlinear tolerance of 10-Gb/s NRZ in a pre-compensated dispersion map. It is observed that even for relatively wide 100-GHz channel-spacing, XPM further reduces the nonlinear tolerance in contrast to periodically-compensated maps.

articleTitle: Tunable Lasers Based on Silica Waveguide Ring Resonators
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We developed a hybrid integrated tunable laser based on waveguide ring resonators using passive alignment technology. A compact chip having a wavelength locker, stable high output power and excellent mass-productivity was achieved.

articleTitle: Local Dispersion Map Deviations in Metro-Regional Transmission Investigated Using a Dynamically Re-Configurable Re-Circulating Loop
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The performance of 40x10.7 Gb/s NRZ-OOK signals is measured in a dynamically reconfigurable recirculating loop experiment with local dispersion map variations up to +/-120 ps/nm and mean residual-dispersion per-span between 10.3-54.0 ps/nm over 28x27dB spans.

articleTitle: Blocking and Waveband Assignment in WDM Networks with Limited Reconfigurability
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: In this paper, we show quantitatively the benefits of using reconfigurable optical add-drop multiplexers (ROADMs) with limited tunable transponders in all-optical networks. We compare two transponder sharing models and two waveband assignment schemes.

articleTitle: Enhanced Self-Coherent Optical Decision-Feedback-Aided Detection of Multi-Symbol M-DPSK/PolSK in particular 8-DPSK/BPolSK at 40 Gbps
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Direct-detection sensitivity for M-DPSK/BPolSK with large M is improved generating self-coherent gain without an actual local oscillator light source by means of a novel optical decision-feedback-aided tapped-delay-line-interferometer, along with a 90deg optical hybrid, and analog-post processing.

articleTitle: Semi-leaky waveguide optical isolator
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A semi-leaky isolator was fabricated by bonding LiNbO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> onto a magneto-optic garnet waveguide. A 1.6mm-long device provides an isolation of 20.2dB at a wavelength of 1.55μm.

articleTitle: Spectrally Efficient DPSK-OCDMA Coherent System Using Integrated Ring-Resonator-Based Coders
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate the highest spectral efficiency of 0.5 bit/s/Hz for a multi-user spectral phase encoded OCDMA system, which operates within an 80 GHz transparent optical window using DPSK format and programmable ring-resonator-based integrated coders.

articleTitle: Light-controlled Reconfigurable Fiber Bragg Gratings Written in Attenuation Fiber
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A novel type of light controlled fiber Bragg gratings written in attenuation fiber is demonstrated. The spectral reconfiguration can be controlled by the pump power, the pumping configuration, the grating position and the fiber attenuation.

articleTitle: Demonstrated 4×4 Gbps Silicon Photonic Integrated Parallel Electronic to WDM Interface
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A 4x4 Gbps microring modulator cascade with the ability to directly convert parallel electrical bus data into multiple-wavelength optical signals in a single silicon-on-insulator waveguide interface is demonstrated with < 10-<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">12</sup>bit error rates.copy2006 Optical Society of America

articleTitle: Millimetre-wave Gigabit/s Wireless-over-Fibre Transmission Using Low Cost Uncooled Devices with Remote Local Oscillator Delivery
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate the first gigabit/s modulated wireless data transmission using uncooled directly modulated lasers for low cost solution with remote millimetre-wave 40 GHz LO. Error free transmission (BER <10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-9</sup>) is achieved for downlink and uplink.

articleTitle: Optimum Design for Coherent Optical OFDM Transmitter
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Optimum design for coherent optical OFDM transmitter has been analyzed. In contract to the direct-detection system, the optimal modulator bias point for the coherent system is π where the nonlinearity and excessive loss are minimized.

articleTitle: Equalization Techniques for 100Mb/s Data Rates on SI-POF for Optical Short Reach Applications
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: In this paper, we propose the combination of 8-PAM modulation, pre-emphasis and adaptive equalization to overcome 1mm-SI-POF bandwidth limitations in optical short reach links. An error-free transmission at 100Mbit/s over 200 m SI-POF is experimentally demonstrated.

articleTitle: Nearly 100 nm bandwidth of flat gain with a double-pumped fiber optic parametric amplifier
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate double-pumped fiber-optical parametric amplifiers with flat and broadband gain spectrum. Using specially fabricated highly non-linear fibers having low variations of the zero-dispersion wavelength and low PMD we obtain flat gain (23.5±1dB) over 95nm.

articleTitle: Fast Switching and Wideband Photonic Beamformer with Flat RF Response and Squintless Scan Performance
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A wideband (>10 GHz) beamformer, based on a photonic true-time-delay, with sub-microsecond angle switching is reported. The smooth microwave transmission (ripples <0.5 dB&<3deg) and superb uniformity among the elements (<0.1 dB&<0.5deg) result in excellent RF performance.

articleTitle: Dual-Pump Four-Wave Mixing in Bismuth-Oxide Highly Nonlinear Fiber for Wide-Band DPSK Wavelength Conversion
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Wide-band wavelength conversion is obtained in a 32-cm highly nonlinear bismuth oxide fiber using dual-pump four-wave mixing. The conversion for a 10-Gb/s NRZ-DPSK signal shows a power penalty below 4 dB over a 30-nm range.

articleTitle: Silica PLC-VOA using suspended narrow ridge structures and its application to V-AWG
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We fabricated a silica PLC-VOA using suspended narrow ridge structures and successfully reduced the power consumption to 20 mW/channel. Using the proposed structures, we demonstrated a 16- channel V-AWG with a compact size of 20 times 17 mm and a low total power consumption of 320 mW.

articleTitle: Considering Transmission Impairments in RWA Problem: Greedy and Metaheuristic solutions
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2007 - 2007 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication and the National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We face the RWA problem considering physical impairments. After proposing a simple, fast but accurate model for the physical layer that considers dynamic impairments, we devise both greedy and metaheuristic algorithms to solve RWA problems.

articleTitle: Multi-layer Network Management System integrated with a Network Planning Tool for IP/Optical integrated network
